articleTitle: SSIM-NET: Real-Time PCB Defect Detection Based on SSIM and MobileNet-V3
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Defect detection is an indispensable part of the print circuit board (PCB) manufacturing process, which could identify problems in the previous manufacturing process to avoid the subsequent meaningless assembly work. However, previous works, e.g., traditional detection approaches fully based on machine learning, which are really too sensitive by some environmental factors. In this work, we improve previous work and propose a new PCB defect detector called SSIM-NET. Our approach is a two-stage detection algorithm including two innovations: 1) In the first step, we use the structural similarity index (SSIM) instead of morphology operator to find out the suspicious regions, it is not easily susceptible to some factors, e.g., illumination variation, slight camera noise, etc. 2) In the second step, in order to reduce the computational cost, we adopt the latest lightweight backbone MobileNet-V3 to classify suspicious regions. The difference is that we add a binary loss that focal loss to accelerate the network coverage. Finally, the accuracy and speed of our approach both achieved the state-of-the-art. Specially, compared with Faster-RCNN, its speed is faster at least 12× but without any loss of accuracy.

articleTitle: AGV Localization Based on Odometry and LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Localization is the key to AGV autonomous navigation. The motion model and the observation model of the AGV are established based on odometry and LiDAR respectively. It is proposed that the estimated position of the AGV is obtained by the odometry, then the accurate location is quickly obtained by matching observed information. The cumulative error of the motion model and the measurement noise of the observation model are considered, the latter is subjected to probability filtering to correct the odometry in the SLAM process. An improved Monte Carlo localization method is proposed, which increases the screening pass rate of effective particles in the initial localization process and improves the efficiency and accuracy of localization.

articleTitle: Robotic Control of Dynamic and Static Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, gesture recognition control has become an important research topic in the field of intelligent robots at home and abroad, and it is a very flexible human-computer interaction method. At present, the use of gesture recognition in industrial production to control robots is mostly a gesture-oriented teaching method, lacking a systematic description of dynamic gestures and static gestures, making it difficult for the robot to understand the complete intention expressed by the operator. The static gesture real-time recognition is centered and the computer vision control in the complex environment realizes the space movement and posture movement of the robot. This way of using the human body language to directly control the robot movement, the human experience, the intention and the manipulator's high efficiency The combination of sustainability and other advantages can accomplish tasks that cannot be accomplished by people or robots alone.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Manufacturing System of Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Global manufacturing is in the midst of a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation driven by information and communication technology. Major technologies such as robotics, digital manufacturing, reinforcement learning, and brain-like computing are reshaping manufacturing technology systems. This paper proposes a sustainable intelligent manufacturing technology system, which is autonomous and controllable. This structure runs through the enterprise equipment layer, control layer and management layer, greatly enhances product innovation capability, and promotes manufacturing to the high end.

articleTitle: Adaptive Walking on Slope of Quadruped Robot Based on CPG
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Compared with the traditional wheeled robot, the largest advantage of quadruped robot is that it has better adaptability to complex terrain environment. In order to adapt to walking from plane to slope, the vestibulospinal reflex model and flexion reflex model are constructed by using foot contact force sensor and impedance controller. At the same time, the reflex models are integrated into CPG network and combined with the kinematics of the robot to obtain environmental information. By adjusting the equilibrium position of each leg of the robot, the quadruped robot can adapt to the slope and complete the smooth transition and walking from flat ground to slope. In this paper, CPG network is constructed based on the Hopf oscillator model. The results verified by the co-simulation of MATLAB and ADAMS show that the proposed method can make the stable transition of the quadruped robot from flat ground to slope and realize the adaptation to the slope.

articleTitle: Kinematics Simulation and Operation Space Analysis of Arc Welding Six-Axis Robot Based on Matlab and Adams
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Taking arc welding robot in the whole process automation of welding as the research object, a theoretical model of six-degree-of-freedom vertical series multi-joint arc welding robot is established by using standard d-h method. Matlab and Adams are used to analyze the theoretical model, and the joint kinematic simulation of Matlab and Adams verifies that the arc welding robot have good kinematic performance. The movement of the welding gun is stable and there is no mutation in the welding process. On the basis of correct theoretical model, monte carlo method is used to solve the operating space of the arc welding robot. The result shows that the operating space designed by the robot is reasonable and can meet the requirements of arc welding.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Digital Printing Quality
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Paper performance has an important impact on the quality of printed matter. This paper mainly discusses the correlation of paper surface performance and digital printing quality in digital printing. Five kinds of paper are selected for experiment. Through the measurement of paper surface performance, the relevance of the impact on printing quality is discussed by the varieties of the correlation effects of whiteness, gloss, smoothness performance, L*a*b* color gamut, solid density and relative contrast. The mathematical model is established between paper performance and digital printing quality. The related influence of digital printing quality is discussed.

articleTitle: The Simulation and Analysis of a New Rescue Robot with Transformable Wheels
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the complex terrains in the working scenes for rescue robots, this paper presents the design of a rescue robot with two switchable modes between wheels and legs. Firstly, according to the research on the relationship between the number of spokes and the motion performance of the wheel, a kind of transformable wheel is designed according to the principle of planar four-link linkage. Secondly, the size of the wheel is determined by studying the internal relation among the structural parameters of the wheel. Finally, the virtual simulation of the robot model is established to study the process of movement mode switching and obstacle passing as well as the movement situation under different gaits, which provides theoretical basis for the control of the robot.

articleTitle: Tomato Processing Defect Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper is mainly representative of agricultural product defect detection technology. Automated machine learning-based technology has become more potential and important to many areas like agricultural sector and food processing industry. Defect detection of vegetables is one of the most important processes after harvest, but this process is usually performed manually and is not efficient because it requires a lot of work and is prone to human error. The proposed defect detection system captures tomato images through a digital camera and analyzes the images using a deep learning network. Through the image collection of tomatoes in different states, the Mask-RCNN machine learning framework is used to realize the feature extraction of tomatoes. On the basis of this, an omni-directional defect detection model of tomato was established to realize the omni-directional detection of tomato. To adapt to the actual business of tomato intelligent defect detection, the tomato defect detection model needs to constantly adjust the model's hyperparameters while having sufficient data sets. This system will help increase the speed, accuracy and cost of an automated lossless grading system. The implementation of the system will be applied in quality grading in areas such as food science and industry that require standardization.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation Study on Logistics Planning in Automatic Plant Factory Based on Tecnomatix Plant Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of plant factory automation, virtual factory technology is gradually applied in the field of plant factory. In this work, we proposed two logistics solutions for the scheme demonstration stage of logistics planning in an automatic plant factory that will be built in Fudong Modern Agricultural Industrial Park, Handan City, Hebei Province. The Tecnomatix Plant Simulation software is used to verify and compare the logistics solutions. Finally, a mechanical design scheme is provided for logistics equipment based on the optimal solution of simulation and TRIZ theory.

articleTitle: Halcon-Based Solar Panel Crack Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Driven by the national new energy policy, China's solar photovoltaic industry has ushered in unprecedented development opportunities. At present, China has become the world's largest producer of photovoltaic modules, and has reached the international advanced level in solar cell manufacturing. However, many enterprises still use manual checking in the process of detecting solar panels. The manual detection is subject to various factors of employees themselves, and it is prone to problems such as low detection efficiency, high false detection rate, high scrap rate and high labor cost. In this paper, a solar panel crack detection device based on the deep learning algorithm in Halcon image processing software is designed for the most common defect in solar panel production process, which can effectively detect cracked solar panels and reduce the rate of defective products in the late stage, improve the production quality of solar cells, and reduce energy waste and labor costs.

articleTitle: Quadrotor UAV Formation High-Order Consistency Formation Control
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, the directed graph is used to model the formation topological relationship, and the formation formation control problem is transformed into the consistency error convergence problem. A formation formation control method is proposed, which is proved by graph theory knowledge and Lyapunov stability theorem. The consistency error of the control system asymptotically converges, and the effectiveness of the formation control method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Position-Based Impedance Control in Cartesian Space of Robot Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The dexterous manipulability of robot manipulators depend on its manipulative dexterity, grasp robustness, and human operability, which greatly influences the ability of humanoid robots for dexterous tasks. Consequently, the control system design and control strategies for dexterous robot manipulators become one of the hot spots in humanoid robots field. In this paper, a compliant control algorithm is proposed for the dexterous hand system. The theoretical analysis of the position-based impedance control algorithm in Cartesian space is carried out. The control structure is established and dynamic model of the algorithm is given. Finally, feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm are verified by designing an impedance control simulation experiment.

articleTitle: UAV Route Planning Based on QPSO Algorithm under Rolling Time Domain Control
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the path planning problem of UAVs in complex environments, a RHC-QPSO path planning algorithm is proposed based on the quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm. The algorithm uses a quadtree to establish an environment model to reduce the storage of environmental information when there are many obstacles. Based on the QPSO algorithm, the UAV path optimization is performed. Combined with the RHC method, the active evasive strategy is adopted for the obstacles. The minimization of and are selected as the process performance index and used as the rolling optimization window. Optimize the indicator and change it to offline calculation for real-time online calculation. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can not only realize the dynamic path planning of UAVs with certain prior knowledge of the map in real time and effectively, but also prevent the UAV from making large maneuvers to avoid obstacles during the planning process. The smoothness of the path improves the safety of the drone.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Robotic Arm with Light Weight and Heavy Load
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The paper presents a multi-joint robotic arm with light weight and heavy duty. It has both light and heavy working modes of operation. Firstly, the motion principle is analyzed and the kinematics model is established. Through TRIZ theory, the range of each articulated arm is determined, then the design of the main load-bearing structure is carried out. The ANSYS simulation analysis is carried out to verify the rationality of the structure. Lastly, the transmission mode and the driven motors are determined and the prototype is produced.

articleTitle: Establishment and Verification of Finite Element Model of Pedestrian Head Based on Accident Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: According to the real accident, the head collision model of SUV and pedestrian was established. Firstly, the PC-CRASH multi-rigid-body dynamics software is used to reconstruct and analyze the accident, and the corresponding pedestrian head dynamic response parameters and pedestrian head injury parameters are derived. Then the pedestrian head impact model is established. The pedestrian head impact parameters (collision velocity and angle) in the accident are taken as the initial strips of finite element simulation. Finally, the validity of the collision model is verified by comparing the degree of sags in the hood of SUV engine and the extent of pedestrian head injury in real accidents with the simulation results. It is of great significance to study the mechanism of head injury and damage assessment in collision accidents.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Automatic Vegetable Harvesting Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Due to the influence of population and environment, the traditional vegetable production methods in China are undergoing changes, and soilless cultivation techniques are gradually receiving attention. The soilless culture of vegetables is neatly arranged and suitable for automatic management. However, in actual production, the harvest of such vegetables is still mostly harvested and the efficiency is low. This design is aimed at the problem of high labor intensity and low efficiency of planting vegetables, combined with manual process analysis and harvesting machinery research, and innovatively designed harvesting institutions for planting vegetables. In the design process, solidworks was used to design the scheme. The design scheme referenced the more mature research results, and selected a reasonable cutting method to reduce the negative influence of vegetable roots on the cutting tool during cutting; using matlab to assist analysis of the linkage mechanism kinematic calculation ensures that the key mechanism has good stress during the cutting process, improves the environment of the mechanism and prolongs its service life. Finally, completes the design and analysis of the planting propulsion mechanism. The development of the facility vegetable automatic harvester completes the automated production process of vegetables.

articleTitle: A Study on the Icon and Layout Design of Device UI in Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As an new emerging design field, the user interface design of the augmented reality device has many characteristics that distinguish it from the design of former electronic device interface in the form of the expression and interaction. In this paper, it takes the user experience as the center to analyze the device user interface in augmented reality environment and to summarize the skeuomorphic and flat design features of the user interface icons during the interaction with the augmented reality product, as well as the impact of the fixed layout and floating layout of the interface on the user experience, and thus to provide reference for the design and application of the user interface of the augmented reality device.

articleTitle: Simulation of Liquid Atomization in Cyclone Atomizer Based on VOF-DPM Coupling Model
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The atomizer is the key equipment in the oil mist lubrication system. Currently, the system usually use venturi tubes for atomization, but the efficiency is not high. In this paper, a cyclone atomizer was used as the research object. The vof-dpm Coupling model, the new module in Fluent 19.0, was used to simulate the atomization process of gasoline from continuous phase to discrete phase. The velocity distribution at different cross sections of the cyclone atomizer was calculated, and the velocity variation regulation of air and gasoline interation was summarized. In addition, the diameter distribution of gasoline droplets was obtained. The diameter was between 3 micrometers and 150 micrometers so that the atomization performance of cyclone atomizer is good. The results of this study provide a reference for the optimal design of the atomizer.

articleTitle: A Method to Solve the Assembly Line Parts Feeding Problem Based on Variable Route
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Recently, the combination of supermarket and tow train can be adopted by more and more automobile producers for parts feeding. This paper focuses on the Assembly Line Parts Feeding Problem (ALPFP), a single tow train, which delivers parts from a supermarket to the workstations' buffer in a mixed-model assembly line, of routing, scheduling, and loading problem to minimize number of tours, routes lengths, and line-side inventory holding costs. In order to enable a reliable part feeding in line with the JIT-principle, the tow train with wagons starts from the supermarket, runs between any two destinations of line-side parts buffer unloading the parts, and finally returns to the supermarket before shortage. In this paper, a new mixed integer mathematical model from nonlinearity to linearity which can get exact solution paves the way for the study.

articleTitle: Vehicle-Mounted with Tracked Robotic System Based on the Kinect
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the research of robot controlling, existing methods are mainly traditional human-computer interactive control methods such as mobile APP or handle. These traditional methods, however, rely on external devices to control the robot, which is inefficient to perform more complex functions. Although the Kinect has more benefits than other sensors in motion recognition, there is still no proper research on motion and gesture recognition of a tracked vehicle robot. Therefore, this paper proposes a research method of vehicle robot system based on Kinect dynamic gesture recognition of depth information. By using the Kinect sensor, we can recognize and obtain information such as human bones and gestures, and finally, realize accurate control of vehicle-mounted robots with multiple gestures.

articleTitle: Research on Online Monitoring and Diagnosis System for Key Equipment Health Status in Intelligent Manufacturing of Metallurgical Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the implementation of intelligent manufacturing of metallurgical enterprises, the requirements for equipment reliability and equipment maintenance management are gradually increasing, and intelligent manufacturing needs to match the predictive maintenance capability. In view of the current problems in the equipment management of LYSteel, LYSteel changes existing maintenance ideas, from regular maintenance to active maintenance based on equipment operating conditions, constructed online monitoring and diagnosis system for key equipment operating status. This paper introduces the core functions and key implementation contents of the system in detail. This online monitoring and diagnosis system provides a basic guarantee for the active maintenance of the equipment management of LYSteel, helping LYSteel to establish a new key equipment management, maintenance, inspection and repair system under the concept of predictive maintenance.

articleTitle: System Fault Simulation Based on Fuel Cell Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: An one-dimensional dynamic model based on PEM fuel cell electrochemical reaction mechanism, energy conservation, mass conservation and empirical data was constructed. The change of the internal state caused by the changes in physical properties and system operating conditions, such as change in membrane water content, and the observable relevant signal response can be simulated by this model. The typical faults commonly happened in the fuel cell system are embedded into this model, and the simulation results are compared to the actual fault data in engineering. It was found that the model can qualitatively reflect the typical faults which can be explained with reasonable mechanism. Based on this model, a typical fault database can be constructed for the subsequent study of fault diagnosis methods.

Author Keywords: PEM Fuel Cell, Dynamic Model, Fault Simulation

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of the Effect of Cargo Viscosity on Sloshing in Tank
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Using the physical model test method, under the first-order natural frequency condition, by analyzing the free surface waveform of the liquid in the tank under different viscosity and the sloshing impact pressure of the side wall, the influence rule of the viscosity change of the liquid cargo on the sloshing of the liquid is obtained. The results show that the lower the viscosity is, the more violent the liquid sloshing is.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Temperature Field of Cargo Oil Microwave Heating Process
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the heating process of traditional oil tanker oil, the thermal efficiency of the oil is not high, the heat loss is large and the operation process is complicated. In order to obtain better heating effect of the oil, the heating efficiency of the oil is improved. Based on the theory of heat transfer and microwave technology, the temperature field of electromagnetic field and fluid heat transfer was coupled. The finite element software COMSOL was used to simulate the temperature field variation characteristics of static underwater microwave heating oil, and the numerical simulation results of existing experiments were verified. The results show that the numerical simulation results of the model agree well with the experimental data, and the accuracy of the numerical method is verified. The distribution of the temperature field of the oil absorption in the heating process is consistent with the electric field distribution, and the absorption capacity of the microwave in the oil medium. Attenuation, vertical oil temperature difference, the upper surface oil temperature is the highest, the microwave absorption capacity is the largest; the whole cabin oil temperature field changes more evenly, indicating that the oil tanker oil heating method is feasible, also for the study of oil tanker cargo steam and Microwave composite heating technology provides a theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Research on the Load Characteristics of the Ball Nozzle Based on the Control Strategy of Stiffness Adaptive Compensation
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper first discusses the application prospect and advantage of the load characteristics of the ball nozzle distinguish from the flexible nozzle. On the influence of the no-linear characteristics to the thrust vector control (TVC), the key factor was searched from the category and identification method of the ball nozzle characteristics. Then one kind of control strategy of stiffness adaptive compensation was provided to solve the problem that the dynamic characteristic of the control system was not meted and proved it's valid after simulation.

articleTitle: Design of a Smart Storytelling Toy Based on Voice Interaction
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of voice recognition technology, voice interaction is becoming more and more popular in everyday life. The application of voice interaction can greatly improve the user experience of toys. In this paper, we design a smart storytelling toy with both fun and educational features for young children. Voice interaction is leveraged to address the issue of the fast retrieval for massive audio files. In addition, emotional communication is introduced to the voice interaction design to attract children's attention and guide their behavior. Finally, the product design scheme including interaction design is implemented and validated through prototyping.

articleTitle: Preventive Maintenance Decision Model for Multi-Station Manufacturing System Subject to System Deterioration
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The qualities of products in a multi-station manufacturing system (MMS) shift from station to station. The rate of unqualified products increases rapidly with the increase of processing procedures. Repeated processing of non-conforming products is a great waste of productivity. In order to reduce the quality loss caused by quality shift, a preventive maintenance (PM) decision model is designed by balancing the reliability of MMS stations. Monte Carlo method is used to calculate the occurrence probability, defect products and expect running time of four maintenance scenarios. An optimization model is established to minimize the expect cost by using PSO algorithm. An ordinary PM model without considering quality shift is established as comparison.

articleTitle: Sinusoidal Pressure Generator Contraction Section Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The key to dynamic pressure calibration is the generation of sinusoidal pressure signals. This paper uses a liquid-gas two-phase piston sinusoidal pressure generator for generating higher frequency pressure signals. The design of the contraction section has a large effect on the sinusoidal pressure generator. The flow field characteristics of the contraction section were simulated by Fluent simulation software. We analyze the frequency response, exit velocity distribution and axial pressure distribution of different contraction curves, then select the appropriate contraction curve and verify it by experiment. The simulation work in this paper provides a reference for the design of liquid-gas two-phase high-frequency sinusoidal pressure generator.

articleTitle: Research on Parameter Optimization of Potato Soil Transportation Separation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to improve the operation effect of sweet potato harvester in China, this paper uses EDEM to analyze the single-factor simulation of the potato soil transport separation mechanism, and analyzes the simulation results by using the collision normal force and transport efficiency of sweet potato as the index parameters. The field experiment was designed to verify, and the test results were consistent with the simulation results, which proved the feasibility of using the discrete element method to simulate the operation process of the potato soil transport separation mechanism. However, the actual operation effect of the common potato soil transport separation mechanism is the result of the joint influence of multiple parameters. Therefore, based on the EDEM-based basic simulation, the collision normal force and the transport efficiency are the optimization objectives, and the orthogonal simulation experiment with interaction is used to optimize the parameters, and two sets of parameter optimization combinations are obtained. Based on the secondary development of EDEM software, the number of bond breaks and the change trend of large soil particles were used as evaluation indexes to simulate the two sets of working parameters, and finally the optimal parameters were obtained. The combination is a bar lift with a line speed of 2.3 m/s, an amplitude of 8 mm, and an inclination of 18°.

articleTitle: Research and Structural Optimization of Heat Dissipation Performance of Plate-Fin Heat Exchanger
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For solving the problem of high oil temperature in a certain engineering machinery transmission system, a method to improve the heat dissipation performance of the heat exchanger by improving the internal structure of the heat exchanger is proposed, which makes the machine work in the normal temperature range. Based on the Colburn analogy equation and the fluid force balance equation, the influence factors of the heat dissipation performance of the water passage in the heat exchanger are analyzed. It can be seen that the cross-sectional area of the fluid passing through the fins is the most important factor affecting the heat dissipation performance of the heat exchanger. Comparing the heat dissipation performance before and after the improvement of the heat exchanger structure, the result shows that the heat dissipation power of the heat exchanger is increased by 18.3%, and the oil temperature of the engineering machinery power transmission system is reduced by 19%, which effectively solves the problem. The error of the heat dissipation coefficient between the method used in this paper and the test verification is within 4.9%, which has certain reference value for solving the excessive heat temperature of other engineering machinery.

articleTitle: Vehicle Speed Accident Reconstruction Based on Event Data Recorder
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to study the role of EDR data in vehicle accident reconstruction, the 15 basic data types of EDR data are analyzed. This paper reconstructs the complete process of 16 car traffic accidents and analyzes the data sources and collision types of EDR. And the trigger threshold range of each collision type is explained, 16 accident cases are reconstructed and analyzed. The typical accident cases are analyzed by EDR data. The vehicle speed and the direction of the force at the time of the collision are combined with the sensitivity parameters. The second reconstruction and comparison of the vehicle speed error of the two reconstruction results show that the relative error of the vehicle speed drops to within 10%, that is, adjusting the EDR sensitivity parameter can effectively reduce the relative error of the vehicle speed.

articleTitle: Vibration Improvement and Dynamic Balance Automatic Optimization of Rotor Compressor
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The mechanism of radial vibration of a rotor compressor is studied, the force acting on the compressor rotor system and the dynamic characteristics of the rotor system are analyzed, and the determination methods of rigid and flexible rotors are established. The optimal dynamic balance optimization scheme is obtained by automatic simulation and optimization analysis of multi-body dynamics, and the accuracy of theoretical calculation is verified by experiments. It provides a theoretical basis for dynamic balance optimization design and vibration improvement of rotary compressor.

articleTitle: Research on Calculation Method of Internal Resistance of Lithium Battery Based on Capacity Increment Curve
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries are the most widely used and reliable power source for electric vehicles. With the development of electric vehicles, the safety performance, energy density, life and reliability of lithium-ion batteries have been continuously improved. However, as the battery ages, the battery performance is degraded, the internal resistance of the battery increases, and the internal resistance of the battery is closely related to the instantaneous charge and discharge capacity of the battery. In addition, in the battery packs connected in series, the battery resistance distribution is closely related to the consistency of the battery pack. In this paper, the lithium iron phosphate battery capacity increment curve (IC curve) was used as the analysis tool and the IC curve obtained by SOC-OCV was selected as the reference curve and the IC curves of the same batch in the battery pack are selected and compared with the reference curve. The voltage difference of the characteristic peaks and the current difference are used to reflect the internal resistance of each monomer. value. On this basis, a mathematical model was established, and the internal resistance of other cells is calculated one by using the characteristic points of I peak and II peak of IC curve obtained by SOC-OCV, so as to reflect the aging consistency of battery package. The actual capacity calculated from the SOC-OCV curve was compared and found to be consistent with the battery aging trend characterized by capacity, which shows that the method can quickly determined the internal resistance of each single cell of the battery pack, and can be applied in the normal charging process of the battery pack. In addition, the resistance values of all the single cells in the battery pack can be obtained in real time. The calculation and control of the battery resistance value is in the same charge state of the battery, the error is small, so it has a certain practical value for the safety diagnosis and early warning of the battery pack.

articleTitle: The Model and Damping Analysis of Disk Gyroscope with (100) Single Crystal Silicon
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The paper presents a MEMS disk resonator gyroscope (DRG) with (100) Single Crystal Silicon and studies about effect of resonant structure asymmetry on performance. The structural asymmetry caused by fabrication errors is characterized by mass and stiffness asymmetry. In order to simulate the asymmetry of mass and stiffness, the density and Young's modulus of 1/2 rings were set with 5%, 10%, 15%, 20% and 25% errors different from the remaining rings. The resonant frequency, thermoelastic damping and anchor loss are calculated by finite element analysis. As the result, the resonator modal and frequency split change with the asymmetry of structure, and the rise of stiffness asymmetry leads the high level of frequency split, which deteriorates dynamic performance of DRG. The anchor loss increases rapidly with the rising of the asymmetry errors. Furthermore, the thermoelastic damping is the dominant energy loss mechanism and improves as the stiffness asymmetry increases.

articleTitle: Research on Control System of Intelligent Valve Positioner
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Intelligent valve positioner(IVP) is widely used in industrial control process as the control core of intelligent regulating valve. Valve position control algorithm is the core of accurate positioning of valve stem position and exact adjustment of valve opening. Smith fuzzy adaptive PID is proposed to solve problems of low control accuracy and long response time of IVP control system. In this paper, the mathematical model of IVP is established and simulation analysis is completed. It is concluded that the valve position control algorithm realizes the accurate control of valve position and meets control precision requirements of valve.

articleTitle: Design of the Facility Vegetable Environment Monitor System of Greenhouse Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To solve the problems of environmental monitoring difficulty and high labor management costs on greenhouse vegetable production management, the paper introduces agriculture Internet of Things frame. It designed a facilities vegetables environmental monitoring system, comprehensively including ZigBee, MCU, sensors, computers and other technology. First, the system can achieve the local remote live view of environmental indicators in greenhouse, such as air temperature and humidity, soil moisture, light intensity and carbon dioxide. Secondly, the system can control the start and stop of greenhouse ancillary facilities through recrimination node, so as to achieve the purpose of precise control of the greenhouse environment. Finally, the system can provide a suitable environment for the growth of vegetable culture and offer a technical means for high yield and high quality of greenhouse vegetables.

articleTitle: Design and Test for Packaging Machine Cutter Based on TRIZ Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of wasting plastic film when packaging with existing packaging machines on the market, the structure optimization design of the multi-milk bag packaging technology system is carried out by using the invention principle, and the experiment is verified. According to the problem of wasting plastic film when packaging the heat sealing machine to determine the technical system and establish the functional model of the system component. First, applying the contradiction analysis, object-field analysis and other methods to systematically analyze the problems existing in the technical system. Then, using the invention principle to generate a series of innovative design solutions. Finally, selecting the optimal solution and design the prototype based on considering the production cost, economic benefit, manufacturing difficulty and other factors. The experimental results show that the improved packaging machine packaging effect is better and saving the material.

articleTitle: Light Field Camera Image Sharpness Enhancement for Underwater Machine Vision Application
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For underwater machine vision application, due to the scattering and absorption of water medium and underwater particles, there are some problems in underwater image, such as low resolution and contrast, fuzzy details, color distortion and so on. According to the single-scale Retinex theory, the underwater scattering imaging model is established to enhance the sharpness of the image, and the image enhancement effect of the scattering imaging model is optimized by using the multi perspective characteristics of light field imaging, so as to further improve the quality of underwater image. The experimental results show that the underwater scattering imaging model and multi perspective optimization algorithm can effectively improve the quality of underwater image.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Novel Miniature Two-Axis Force Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of bionic robot intelligence, the adaptability to unknown environment and dexterous operation of tiny objects put forward higher requirements on the performance of the robot's end actuators. The multi-dimensional force sensor is the core component of the robot's perception of external forces and smart operation. Therefore, this paper introduces a method for a kind of two-dimensional force sensor for robot finger joint torque measurement, including elastomer structure and micro resistance strain gauge bridge design. After measuring experiment and algorithm calibration, ideal output characteristic curve is obtained, verifying the feasibility and effectiveness of the method of miniature two-dimensional force sensor for bionic robot finger.

articleTitle: Optimization Method for Heat Dissipation Micro-Channel of 3D System in a Package
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the high-power 3D-SiP thermal problem, traditional solutions often optimize heat dissipation from new materials or new structures, which may increase the manufacturing process complexity of 3D-SiP and bring more trouble. So this paper proposes an optimization method to improve the heat dissipation performance of high-power 3D-SiP from the structure and layout of micro-channels. Firstly, the cross-section shape parameters and the number of micro-channels are optimized, using the Design of Experiments method(DOE). Secondly, the Fractal theory and the fin type micro-channel are combined and applied to the micro-channel layout optimization design. Three new layouts are proposed in this paper: parallel fin type micro-channel layout, stagger fin type micro-channel layout and tree fin type micro-channel layout. Comparing junction temperature, chip temperature difference and package thermal resistance, the tree fin type micro-channel layout is better. This paper provides an effective solution for thermal design of high-power 3D-SiP, which reduces the chip junction temperature by 5.69°C and the thermal resistance by 37.44%.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Design Method of Complex Products
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to accelerate the speed of product development and improve efficiency, the paper proposes a combination of genetic algorithm and case-based reasoning to design complex products. The genetic algorithm is applied to the overall design of the user's design requirements, and then according to the multi-level characteristics, the complex products are subdivided, and each part is coded, selected, crossed, and mutated. Finally, a new solution is selected and stored. The stored solution is used as a case library, and the case is matched and modified by case reasoning, and the newly generated case is stored in the case library. Detailed parameters and dimensions of each part of the structure and components can be obtained by case reasoning.

articleTitle: Research Progress on Defrosting Strategy of Heat Pump System Heat Exchanger Outside for EV
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Frost formation on heat exchanger outside of heat pump air conditioning system will decrease the heat exchange efficiency, thus heating capacity and COP of the system fall with the range of EV. It's necessary to apply a practicable defrost strategy with high efficiency for a normal operating heat pump system. This study presents a review of frost formation's impacts, influence factors, main defrosting manners and the determinant condition of defrosting. It's suggested that defrosting determination from several aspects can improve accuracy and reduce energy consumption.

Author Keywords: electric vehicle, heat pump system, defrosting strategy

articleTitle: Development and Application of Underground Intelligent Explosive Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the present situation and development trend of charging blasting process in underground metal mines in China, introduces the key technology of intelligent explosive field mixed loading vehicle for underground mine. The research focuses on the autonomous driving and barrier technology of the underground intelligent explosive vehicle, the remote (range of visibility) wireless remote control and automatic hole finding technology of the working arm, the automatic sending and returning of the explosive pipe and the identification technology of the bottom of the hole. The industrial application experiment of underground intelligent explosive mixed loading vehicle in Fankou Lead Zinc mine is introduced. The application results show that the underground explosive vehicle in China has fully realized the automation and intelligence of underground charging. This equipment effectively improves the charging efficiency and safety.

articleTitle: Mode Energy Ratio Analysis Using Pulse Signals for Diagnosis of Pregnancy Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This work demonstrates a flexible piezoelectric pulse sensing system combined with the mode energy ratio (MER) analysis in order to detect human pulses and reveal pregnant conditions. According to the pulse diagnosis principle of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), the flexible piezoelectric sensor is used to realize digital and intelligent pulse acquisition. And the algorithm of MER based on empirical mode decomposition (EMD) is proposed to describe energy distribution of pulses in different pregnancy status. The experiment results of 83 female volunteers' MER analysis indicate that the identification and warning of pregnancy status and physical health indicators are realized.

articleTitle: Human-Machine Hybrid Enhanced Intelligent Design of Aircraft Structural Parts Based on Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aircraft structural parts are typical small batch, multi-variety product, which is not conducive to the accumulation and reuse of knowledge, affecting and restricting the design of aircraft structural parts, and thus affecting the development progress and cycle of the aircraft. In this paper, a method for the design of sophisticated aircraft structural parts is proposed, to research on human-machine hybrid enhanced intelligent design of aircraft structural parts based on knowledge. The research includes human-machine mixture enhanced intelligent design technology, knowledge-based digital template design technology for aircraft structural parts, rule-based human-machine hybrid enhanced intelligent parameter design technology and case-based reasoning human-machine combination enhanced intelligent variant design technology, quickly building the aircraft structure design model, and summarizing the relevant knowledge in the design process to improve design efficiency. The research results show that this method can effectively solve the design problems of aircraft structural parts, and provide strong technical support for improving research and development ability and accumulating reusable design knowledge. At the same time, the research results can be applied to the design of other complex product parts.

articleTitle: Axial Contact Stiffness Analysis of the Ball Screw for Aerospace Electromechanical Servo System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper takes the aerospace electromechanical servo system as the research object, combs the electromechanical coupling parameters that affect the electromechanical servo system. The effects of mechanical and electrical parameters on the characteristics of aerospace electromechanical servo system are analyzed to provide theoretical basis for the design of electromechanical servo system.

articleTitle: A Multi-Module Soft Robotic Arm with Soft End Effector for Minimally Invasive Surgery
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Soft robots are designed to interact safely with environment because of its high structural softness, good environmental adapt ability, and strong biocompatibility compared with traditional rigid robots. At present, most of minimally invasive surgery still rely on traditional robotic surgical tool. However, rigid medical devices are easy to cause secondary damage to the human body. Based on the concept of bionics, a minimally invasive surgical flexible manipulator with multiple degrees of freedom was designed in this paper. The multi-module robotic arm consists of three different units, including: bending unit, twisting unit and extending unit. In addition, the fiber line embedded in each module enhances the stiffness of the manipulator. Two flexible clamps are designed and integrated at the end of the manipulator to provide good performance in actual operation. This work reports the design and manufacturing process of the manipulator, the analysis of the moving workspace, and the experimental test results of the soft robotic arm.

Author Keywords: Minimally invasive surgery, soft robotics, fiber reinforced actuation, soft end effectors, fluidic actuation

articleTitle: Remote Control System of Semiconductor Air Conditioning on Vehicle Based on 4G Network
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In hot summer, when a car owner just enters a car exposed to the sun, he will feel very hot and unbearable. To solve this problem, a remote control system of Semiconductor Air Conditioning in Vehicle Based on 4G Network is designed. Before the owner is ready to use the car, he can use the APP of mo-bile phone to check the temperature in the car and control the semiconductor air conditioner in the car to cool the car ahead of time through the 4G network. Semiconductor refrigeration technology is used in the system. The mobile APP of Android system communicates with the vehicle-mounted 4G module through the cloud server, and the vehicle-mounted 4G module and the vehicle-mounted MCU which controls the semiconductor air-conditioning and temperature sensor communicate with each other through the serial port. Thus, the car owner can use the mobile APP to control the vehicle-mounted semi-conductor air-conditioning remotely and check the working status and temperature information of the vehicle-mounted air-conditioning. The experimental results show that the re-mote control system of vehicle semiconductor air conditioning based on 4G network has excellent reliability and good cooling performance.

articleTitle: An Overview of Energy-Saving Schemes with Cooperative MIMO in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Energy efficiency is an essential criterion of a wireless sensor network, and CMIMO is proved to be an effective way to achieve high energy efficiency. Although some breakthroughs have been made in this area, the difficulty of applying these schemes to a practical CMIMO model can hardly be overcome. Several state-of-the-art CMIMO models, which have managed to enhance energy efficiency from different aspects are surveyed in this article. The listed strategies include diversity gain, data aggregation, sleep rate, and clustering. Correspondingly, the transmitter side, receiver side, transmitted data quantity, and working mechanism are taken into consideration. Moreover, all mentioned technologies are explained and compared in terms of strategy, purpose and remaining issues. Several challenges are given in the end.

articleTitle: Multi Focus and Multi-Source Image Fusion Based on Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to realize the image fusion of multi focus and multi-source acquisition, in this paper a method based on deep learning model and DT-CWT image fusion is proposed. Firstly, the base parts and detail features of the image were separated, the base parts was denoised and filtered by DT-CWT, and the fusion base parts were obtained; depth learning model VGG-S was selected to extract the detail features of the image, and then the fusion details were obtained by multi-layer fusion strategy. Finally, the maximum gradient value is used to select the detail features to obtain the fusion details. The fusion base parts and details features were overlapped and reconstructed to obtain the fusion image. The algorithm not only retains the significant features of the image, but also makes the fused image obtain more detailed feature information. In the process, the noise was reduced. The subjective and objective evaluation results are improved obviously.

articleTitle: Prediction of Vibration Characteristics of Mechanical Bearing Based on a Novel Grey Model
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Shafting vibration data is one of the key parameters that can characterize shafting running state. Therefore, in this paper, vibration signals with significant bearing fault characteristic information are selected as the research object. The trend of its development is predicted. Since it is difficult to collect mechanical bearing data, the grey prediction theory which can be used to predict the bearing vibration signal development data is selected. In addition, due to the defects of the traditional grey prediction theory in the selection and calculation of parameters in the model, the paper introduces the particle swarm optimization algorithm to carry out the study on the optimization of the parameters in order to form PGM (1,1). Finally, the optimization sequence of the parameters of the grey prediction model is clarified through the example analysis and calculation. Therefore, the PGM (1,1) model proposed in this paper has a higher prediction accuracy and has certain theoretical value for the study of the service life of mechanical bearings.

articleTitle: Study on Digital Inspection and Planning Technology of Aviation Sheet Metal Parts
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Modern aviation products have higher requirements on the quality of sheet metal parts. In order to improve the detection efficiency, we adopt the digital detection and measurement methods instead of the traditional one. The method of digital detection uses CAA tools to carry out secondary development of CATIA to establish a digital inspection planning system for sheet metal parts. This paper proposes to use the CATIA secondary development function to access the model information of the sheet metal parts in the formula editor of CATIA, and accurately extract the feature information of the sheet metal parts. Then the digital detection planning system connects the detection planning module with the feature tolerance query module to improve the accuracy of detection planning. Finally, the research on the output of the inspection plan information based on the IPXML based detection scheme web page publishing technology and the detection report generation technology is studied.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Characteristic Research of Product Vibration Test Fixture Based on High Frequency Response Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Servo products usually bear harsh mechanical environment under real flight condition. In order to assess the reliability and effectiveness of servo products, it is necessary to conduct mechanical tests such as vibration test on servo products and analyze whether the test results meet the design requirements. The product structure cannot be directly connected with the shaking table, it is necessary to design special fixture to transfer the vibration force of the vibrating table to the specimen. The transfer characteristics and frequency response characteristics of the vibration testing fixture have a great influence to the accuracy of vibration test. It can even affect the success or failure of the experiment. The vibration table, the tooling fixture and the product constitute a complex vibration test system. The structure design of vibration fixture occupies a pivotal position in the vibration test system. Practice shows that the success of the vibration test and the credibility of the test result closely related to the structure design, material choice, manufacturing process, install and use level.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Analysis of Oil Heating Process of Oil Tanker in Arctic Route
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In recent years, with the opening of Arctic routes, the cargo oil heating technology of Arctic routes has become a growing concern. In the transportation process of cargo oil tankers, because the cargo oil has high viscosity, it needs to be heated in advance in order to prevent the oil products from cooling below the freezing point under the influence of external conditions, which will lead to the change of oil quality and the difficulty of discharge. However, excessive heating will lead to increased energy consumption and fuel waste, increased ship operating costs and increased marine environmental pollution. In this paper, COMSOL software is used to simulate the difference between cargo oil heating in Arctic low temperature environment and cargo oil heating at room temperature, and the most economical and energy saving heating method is found to reduce marine environmental pollution.

articleTitle: Study on Safety of Micro-Cultivator under Backward Driving Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, the safety of the micro-cultivator under backward driving conditions is studied. Firstly, a test bench was built, and 9 groups of experiments in which the operator fell back and fell down under different working conditions were designed. Through the industrial computer and high-speed camera, the attitude data of the micro-cultivator and image data of man-machine experiments were obtained in real time. Secondly, the test data was analyzed preliminary, and the influencing factors and control methods of the micro-cultivator's safety was discussed in the laboratory environment. Finally, the attitude data of the micro-cultivator in normal field operation were obtained through field experiments and compared with the laboratory results. The test results show that too high or too low handle height and large throttle opening will significantly increase the accident rate. When the height of the handle is reasonably designed, the stopping method of micro-cultivator based on attitude recognition has a high accident avoidance rate. This method is superior to the method stipulated in the "Agricultural Industry Standard of the People's Republic of China NY2189-2012 - Safety Technical Requirements for Handheld Tillers".

articleTitle: A Method of Planar Multi-Segment Five-Degree Polynomial Trajectory Planning for Simplified Obstacles
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: It is proposed that under the prescribed conditions, the obstacle spree is simplified by the minimum outer ball method, and the robot end ensures that the speed acceleration reaches the five target points in the working surface under the continuous conditions of the operating conditions, and compares the shortest distance of the track line to the track point of the simplified post-center point to avoid touching, And change the parameters when intersecting the obstacle to re-plan the trajectory.

articleTitle: A Lock Unit and Interlocking Device for Electrostatic Precipitator
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The electrostatic precipitator noumenon usually has about ten manholes, and the inside of the manholes is the electric field with tens of kilovolt. Therefore, the safety of electrostatic precipitator manholes is particularly important. At present, most electrostatic precipitator manholes only use a single electronic or electrical safety interlock protection. These methods are feasible in principle, but they are not suitable for the bad operating environment of electrostatic precipitators, such as high temperature, high voltage, strong interference, strong corrosion and so on, and the above ways still have high operating costs, difficulty in maintenance and repair, and poor system stability and low safety. This paper aims at the above-mentioned technical and security issues existing in the current electrostatic precipitator manholes and provides a new type of safety lock unit and interlocking device for electrostatic precipitators. The device herein has been used the brand-new design concept which achieves electrical safety interlocking through mechanical interlocking, and it guides people to operate the equipment properly and eliminates the adverse consequences caused by human factors, fundamentally preventing the occurrence of fatal accident such as electric shock. The device herein has many advantages such as simple structure, easy installation, convenient use, high temperature resistance, corrosion resistance, stable operation, high security, reliability and durability, so it has high practical value and promotion value.

articleTitle: A New Fast Matching Algorithm for Angle-Adaptive Grayscale Templates
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing gray-based template matching algorithm is not resistant to rotation and slow operation, combined with fast Fourier algorithm and image pyramid search strategy, a new fast matching algorithm for angle-adaptive grayscale templates was designed. Firstly, the image is preprocessed to reduce the noise interference during matching. Secondly, the multi-angle to-be-detected gallery is built by rotating the sub-image to be matched, which solves the problem of contour artifact caused by template rotation. Finally, the FFT-based NCC algorithm is used to measure the similarity. Combined with the image pyramid search strategy and the indented search step method, the computational complexity is reduced and the robustness is improved. And this algorithm is compared with the traditional anti-rotation algorithm during experiments. Experiments show that the proposed method achieves good results when the angle deviation is large and the image matching probability is low or mismatched.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Lubrication System for Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Lubrication system is an important part of wind turbine. with the development trend of large-scale wind turbine, the probability of failure of lubrication system increases gradually, so it is very important to improve the stability of lubrication system. In this paper, the heat generation of gear box is calculated by Matlab modeling, and the heat dissipation power of lubrication system is defined. combined with the innovation of structure and the optimization of adaptive control system, the adaptive lubrication system of gear box of wind turbine is designed by using AMESim software. The oil temperature, oil pressure and oil quality of the lubrication system can be adjusted adaptively under the action of sensors and controllers in order to meet the operating environment and working state of the wind turbine. The wind turbine gear box adaptive lubrication system ensures the lubrication environment of the wind turbine gear box under extreme weather and extreme working conditions, can effectively reduce the wear and tear between the gear box motion parts, and reduce the probability of wind turbine failure shutdown. The reliability of wind turbine is improved and the working life of wind turbine is prolonged.

articleTitle: Study on a New Numerical Method for Solving Heat Conduction Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, a new numerical method, the half boundary method (HBM) is studied. HBM reduced the order of the basic equation by substitution, and then calculated the relationship between the adjacent two nodes on the geometric model by integral solution, and recurred to the relationship between any node on the model and the boundary point. HBM is a small-storage, high-precision, fast and efficient numerical calculation method, with few unknowns and non-iterative innovation nodes, which can meet the requirements of accurate acquisition of real-time temperature field in the case of less computational resources. HBM calculation schemes of one and two dimensions in Cartesian coordinate system are derived in detail. The result of HBM calculation is compared with the result of FVM calculation in the corresponding example. It is found that when the number of nodes is small, the calculation accuracy of HBM is much higher than that of FVM. When the number of nodes is large, both HBM and FVM have high accuracy, but HBM calculation time is shorter. HBM calculation results is provided by MATLAB programs.

Author Keywords: numerical calculation, half boundary method, finite volume method, MATLAB

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Weld Tracking Device with Different Wet Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The cooling system in the welding tracking device with wet air was developed. The weld tracking device was simulated by a three-dimensional numerical model to know the feasibility of the cooling system. The characteristics of device temperature change under different wet conditions were analyzed with the air inlet relative humidity ranging from 0 to 100%. The results show that the overall temperature of the device after cooling decreases with the increase of relative humidity (RH) under the same operating conditions. Under four different ambient temperatures, the temperature drop was most noticeable when the device was cooled by wet air with a relative humidity of 10%. The higher the ambient temperature is, the greater the temperature difference will be, which shows that the wet air cooling effect with an RH of 10% is stronger than that of dry air.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hydraulic Hammer Capacity under Different Inclination
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the existing construction of raked piles, the influence of inclination on the capacity of hydraulic hammers still needs to be explored. This paper focuses on the analysis of the ascending and descending process of the hammer during piling. The mathematical model of hydraulic hammer motion is established by Simulink, and the simulation calculation is carried out to obtain the system pressure, hammer velocity and acceleration during movement. The results show that the velocity and acceleration fluctuate within a certain range due to pressure fluctuations inside the hydraulic hammer. Compared with the hammering process of the vertical piles, the data proves that when the hammer works, the blow energy and frequency are lower. This paper can analyze the applicability of hydraulic hammer for oblique pile and provide technical support for the construction of raked pile foundation.

articleTitle: The Research and Simulation of Kinematics through the Method of Spatial Projection for Dual-Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of coordinated motion for dual-robot, this paper firstly calculated the matrix of coordinate rotation between the two robots by using the method of spatial projection, and secondly, obtained the relative position and attitude between the two robots. Then, the kinematics model of the dual-robot was established through MATLAB. Finally, in the established Dual-Robot model, the two robots took circular motion to verify the feasibility of coordinated motion for dual-robot model after obtaining the relative position and attitude. The simulation results show that the issue of coordinated motion for dual-robot is solved by proposing the method of spatial projection.

articleTitle: Dual Method for Problems of Transversely Isotropic Elastic Solids
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For problems of transversely isotropic elasticity, the semi inverse method is usually adopted according to the Saint Venant principle in Euclidean space. However, the result of this method is not accurate since the local effect is neglected in the computation. In this paper, the governing equations of Hamiltonian system are constructed by using dual variables. According to the characteristics of Hamiltonian matrix operators and the method of variable separation, all the analytical solutions of transversely isotropic elastic plane is obtained, and the complete solution space is established. In fact, the solution of any problem can be expressed as a linear combination of these basic solutions. In the numericl calculation, the problem of fixed end constraints is studied, and the stress concentration caused by boundary constraints is described.

articleTitle: Research on Barge Stability Automatic Adjustment Method of Jacket Sliding into Water
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: There are many uncertain factors in the traditional deep-water jacket sliding into the water. The data cannot be fed back in real time during the operation, and the construction operation cannot be adjusted in time, which leads to the high risk of the traditional deep-water jacket slipping and the low working efficiency. In this paper, the technology of automatic adjustment of the stability of the jacket sliding into the water barge is studied. During the sliding process of the jacket into the water, the distance of the jacket is measured by the distance sensor to calculate the offset of the barge of the barge. Adjustments are made to improve the stability of the barge and reduce the maximum stress on the barge during the slipping process, making the whole work process more safe, improving work efficiency and shortening the construction period.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Baffle Height on Liquid Sloshing Characteristics in Tank
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Due to the increasing demand for shipping, the problem of the stability and safety of the tank structure caused by liquid sloshing has also been paid more attention. This paper builds a three-dimensional model and creates a numerical model based on the VOF method. The effect of the height of the vertical baffle on the sloshing characteristics such as waveform variation, flow field distribution, and sloshing pressure is studied. The results show that the higher the height of the vertical partition, the better the anti-sway effect.

articleTitle: Research on a Digital Watermarking Algorithm for Color Image Based on Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform (DTCWT)
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a digital watermarking algorithm for color image based on Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform (DTCWT). It decomposes the color watermark image M in the RGB color space into three channels, i.e. R, G and B, and then applies Arnold transform on them respectively. It then applies DCT (Discrete Cosine Transform) and DFT (Discrete Fourier Transform) on the scrambled watermarks in the frequency domain. The algorithm applies Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform (DTCWT) on the color carrier image, and uses the third-level low-frequency sub-bands of its real part as the embedded sub-bands. It then embeds all the above-mentioned watermarks into these sub-bands. Finally, it applies inverse Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform on the color carrier image embedded with the color watermark to embed the color watermark into it. Watermark extraction is the inverse process of watermark embedding. Experimental results show that this algorithm features high imperceptibility and robustness.

Author Keywords: color image, watermark, Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform

articleTitle: Design and Kinematics on Biased Channel Retractable Continuum Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Continuum manipulators are type of hyper-redundant robots that without traditional rigid-links, and their intrinsic properties assure continuum manipulators can work in highly unstructured environments. To extend the potential applications of continuum manipulators, this paper presents a novel biased channel retractable (BCR) continuum manipulator. BCR continuum manipulator possesses a hollow channel when reserving its main backbone, and this structure provides the manipulator 'swallow' functions without sacrificing the stiffness generated by the backbone. This paper also establishes its kinematics model based on constant curvature assumption, and experimental result validates its correctness.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Experimental Study of the Flow Field in the Cavity of the High Speed Blend Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The high speed blend machine is a new type of home appliance that can produce a variety of beverages. Its biggest feature is the high juice rate caused by the high speed of the motor, high nutrient retention and high absorption rate after breaking the wall. In the process of using the high speed blend machine, the design of different brands of high speed blend machine is not enough, and the skin residue of fruit and vegetable materials remains, which makes the crushing effect of the material unsatisfactory and affects the taste of drinking. Therefore, the research on the crushing performance of the high speed blend machine to improve the breaking rate of the fruit and vegetable materials has practical application value. We established a simplified model of the high speed blend machine by Solidworks software. We established control equation of the flow field based on the multiple reference system method, and then used the FLUENT software to simulate the flow field of the material. We analyzed the velocity distribution and the turbulent energy distribution of the flow field in the blend machine cavity, and summarized the motion law of the fluid in the cavity. The juice making performance was analyzed by changing the blade structure and the rotational speed. The feasibility of the numerical simulation results was verified, so as to provided basis for the improvement of the structure and control mode of household food processor.

articleTitle: Numerical Optimization and Experimental Study of Cutting Performance with Abrasive Water Jet
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to dispose of various explosives safely and efficiently, the paper studied the organic combination between pre-mixed abrasive jet cutting technology and robot technology. Through using this combination technology to complete the design and experiment of cutting various explosives, and the expected results had achieved. It showed that the cutting performance and parameters can be used for safe and efficient optimization design, which can provide technical support for subsequent research.
