articleTitle: Innovative Design of Seedling Transplanting Mechanism Based on TRIZ Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Seedling transplanting mechanism is a part of the three dimensional vegetable planting production line, which the structural design has some harmful effects on the normal operation of the entire production line. In order to solve the problems for the seedling transplanting mechanism, the TRIZ theory was applied to optimize the structural design from the following aspects: First, the key problems were found by the functional analysis tool, and then were used the engineering contradiction and the Altshuller's matrix to analyze the problems, which the innovation design was put forward under the guidance of the invention principles. Finally, the innovative design scheme was evaluated and the best design was selected. It was found that the success rate of seedlings was about 90 % in practical use, which verified the feasibility of optimal design. This paper provides a reference for solving the optimization design problem.

articleTitle: Slicing Principle and Cutter Design for the Arc Internal Tooth of Pin Gear Housing in RV Reducer
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The manufacturing process of key parts in RV reducer is one of the key technologies affecting mass production of RV reducer. In order to improve the manufacturing accuracy and efficiency of the pre-grinding process of the circular arc teeth in the pin gear housing of RV reducer, the slicing technology is applied to the arc internal tooth processing for the first time. Firstly, the cutting principle of the pin gear housing slicing is analyzed, and then the motion model of the slicing process is established. Based on the kinematic model of gear slicing, the geometric design of the cutting edge and faces of slicing cutter is carried out according to the principle of surface conjugation. Finally, the cutting test of the new cutter is carried out, which proves that the new cutter has excellent cutting performance and can be used for mass processing of circular arc teeth in RV reducer.

articleTitle: A Modified Differential Evolution Algorithm for Constrained Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Many engineering design problems can be transformed into constrained optimization problems (COPs) which are usually very challenging for optimization algorithms. Differential Evolution (DE) has better global searching ability than traditional optimization algorithms. However, the drawbacks are also obvious: (1) The performance of DE depends largely on parameters. (2) Constraint handle technique (CHT) is necessary for COPs since DE is essentially an unconstrained optimization algorithm. This study sets up a stable optimization algorithm for COPs by combining Differential Evolution Algorithm with Strategy Adaptation (SADE) and a novel CHT. This paper proposes a simple and easy repair strategy (RP), which needn't to introduce other parameters or change the structure of algorithm. The specific operation is to repair the non-feasible solution by constructing sub-problems. To verify its superiority, the proposed Repair Strategy-Differential Evolution Algorithm with Strategy Adaptation (RP-SADE) was applied to the 2018 IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC2018) and one engineering application. The results show that the proposed RP-SADE has good comprehensive performance by considering computational efficiency and convergence accuracy.

articleTitle: Effect Analysis of Skidding Damage on Cylindrical Roller Bearing Performance Based on Model and Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, the cause and extension process of initial skidding friction point are analyzed based on the working condition and mechanical model of aero-engine cylindrical roller bearing. Then the formation mechanism of bearing skidding damage is indicated. The effect of skidding damage is evaluated based on the model study, damage morphology analysis and experimental verification. The results show that skidding damage is formed mainly due to unlubricated friction between roller and inner steel sleeve because the oil film is crushed. Skidding damage is conducive to rotate rollers and match linear speed between rollers with inner steel sleeve. Skidding damage is conducive to roller rotation and linear velocity match with steel sleeve. And skidding damage will not expand or deteriorate when subsequent rollers pass through skidding stripe. So skidding damage does not affect the working safety of the bearing.

articleTitle: Design Improvement and Finite Element Analysis of Ceramic Gas Kiln Steel Structure Frame
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: According to the design of 69m ceramic gas tunnel kiln designed by a kiln manufacturer, the kiln structure was optimized to be a flat-top kiln roof, and also designed a flat-top kiln roof support hanger. We intercepted 2m from 69m steel structure frame for finite element analysis to calculate its strength stiffness. On this basis, we optimized with this steel structure frame. This paper can be used for in relevant kiln or similar engineering design.

Author Keywords: Tunnel kiln, Flat-roof Support Frame, Design Improvement, FEM

articleTitle: Deep Sea Laser Scanning System for Underwater In-Situ Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, a novel laser scanning system for deep sea in-situ measurement was developed. Firstly, the main components of the prototype were introduced separately. Then, the performance of the system was tested and analyzed in a tank filled with water with a standard ball bar. Results showed that the laser scanning system in water can achieve high precision. In addition, the prototype was placed in deep sea to verify the performance of the in-situ measurement. The measured targets are well reconstructed, as well as the high precision of underwater in-situ measurement was obtained.

articleTitle: An Efficient Structure Stiffness Topology Optimization Strategy under Crash Loads Using Reduced Equivalent Static Loads Method
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper presents a new method using reduced equivalent static loads for structural topology optimization design under crash loads. At each cycle, crash dynamic analysis and static model order reduction are performed to obtain the nonlinear displacement vector and reduction stiffness matrix respectively. Once the RESLs are built by multiplying the reduction stiffness matrix and the nodal displacement vector at the time with maximal internal energy, the size of the equivalent static loads can be reduced and their position can be transferred. The linear static topology optimization is performed under the RESLs, and the optimization results are filtered into a black-white design for the crash simulation to avoid the mesh distortion issue. The process is repeated until the convergence criteria are satisfied. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated by investing two numerical examples. The results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the numerical stability and convergence, as well as, provide a feasible strategy for the topology optimization design of engineering structures under crash loads.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of Discharge Rate of Silo Device Based on Dynamic Arching Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The conical silo and wedge-shaped hopper in the discharge system of ceramic press are important devices for storing and transferring ceramic powder. The conical silo stores ceramic powder and delivers the powder to the wedge-shaped hopper, which distributes the powder evenly in the grating. In order to provide sufficient supply quantity for brick pressing or improve the production efficiency of brick pressing, it is necessary to accurately predict the discharge rate of conical silo and wedge-shaped hopper. Based on dynamic arching theory and considering the influence of structure size, this paper deduces the prediction model of discharge rate of conical silo and wedge-shaped hopper, and proves the accuracy of the prediction model through discharge experiment.

articleTitle: Effect of Lap Ratio on Microstructure and Properties of Laser Cladding Ni Based Coating on 45 Steel
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on 45 steel, Ni35 powder was cladding on the surface of the substrate by fiber laser. In the experiment, by changing the distance of the laser beam moving vertically along the scanning direction when two adjacent laser cladding passes, the multi pass cladding layer is prepared by using the synchronous powder feeding method. The effects of different lap ratio on the morphology, microstructure and microhardness of nickel based coating were studied. When other parameters are suitable, the lap ratio of 22.26% can make the cladding layer combine with the matrix better, reduce the defects at the lap joint, obtain the cladding layer with dense structure and good performance, and high hardness.

articleTitle: Topological Graph Representation Method to Design Multistage Planetary Differential Gear Trains
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The design of multistage planetary gear trains is complicated and difficult to obtain completed configuration scheme. Purpose of this paper is to give a method to design the configuration scheme of multistage planetary differential gear trains. Firstly, a new topological representation of planetary gear transmission is put forward. Then, three kinds of combinations of basic components in planet gear set are obtained based on the mathematical combination theory. Lastly, the connection types of basic components in planet gear set are changed, all possible configuration schemes of NW two stages planetary differential gear train are then obtained . The result shows that it is a way for innovative design of multistage planetary gear transmission.

articleTitle: Rule Adjustment Method for Self-Organizing Control Rules Oriented to Urban Traffic Signals
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to solve the adaptability problem of urban traffic signal self-organizing control rules brought by the complexity of urban traffic flow, which makes the adaptability of the rules mismatching with part of working conditions, a method of adjusting the rules of self-organizing control under urban traffic signals is proposed. The traffic congestion level of each lane at the current intersection are chosen as the decision information. The current intersection and its adjacent intersections are defined as a self-organizing unit under real-time. The switching of rule is based on fluid dynamics. The coordination of the green phase duration are under the traffic flow distribution principle, all above constitute the self-organizing control system of urban traffic signals. Each self-organizing control unit, which with its complexity caused by road composition, connection of the intersections and traffic flow randomness, makes the local rule with segmentation adjustment according to the traffic flow parameters to improve the adaptability of the intersection under complex traffic changes. The simulation experiment shows that the validity of the segmental adjustment of traffic flow parameters to the original local rule set is verified. It is concluded that the phase improvement effect of saturated traffic flow with larger relative traffic flow parameters is more obvious. This method is expressed in segments by self-organizing rules.

articleTitle: A Uniform Balancing Method for High-Speed Rotor Bearing System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Since rotor run out and bearing vibration are not considered simultaneously and are analyzed independently, it is common for one vibration amplitudes to reduce and the other to rise during the balancing process. In order to suppress the unbalance vibration of rotor and bearing at the same time, the dynamic model of an unbalanced rotor system is developed and verified to analyze its dynamic characteristics, based on this, the optimal sensor placements of the rotor bearing system are given. Then, an accurate description of the unbalanced state is presented, and the uniform balancing method is proposed based on the optimization objective function of the unbalance vectors. Finally, the experimental results reflect the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Structural Design of Drying Chest in Tea Dryer
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The drying box of the tea dryer is the key equipment for tea drying. It is generally transferred to the surface of the tea leaf by hot air, and the temperature of the tea rises smoothly in the drying chest due to the controllable temperature and flow rate. The design is to optimize the structure of the traditional drying chest, optimize the material selection, optimize the manufacturing process, to improve the space utilization rate, drying efficiency and drying pass rate of the drying chest, model the AUTOCAD in the design of the drying chest model, and use SOLIDWORKS for strength test. Through theoretical calculation and software simulation analysis, the expected design goals are basically achieved.

articleTitle: Study on One Type of 4-Position Load Simulator System Technology Based Large Moment of Inertia and High Torque
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this paper, one type of 4-position load Simulator system is taken as the research object. By establishing the mathematical model of mixed load and analyzing the effect of surplus force, the mechanical structure, load control and software development of simulated load are described. A hybrid loading technique based on simultaneous simulation of high stiffness inertia adjustable friction loading is proposed and the load control system is modeled and simulated. The hybrid loading technology has the advantages of high stiffness, adjustable inertia, adjustable damping, adjustable hinge moment, etc. It can accurately simulate the various load parameters of the nozzle, and provide reliable support for testing the real characteristics of the electromechanical servo system under load conditions.

articleTitle: Hybrid Trefftz Finite Element Method for the Transversely Isotropic Piezoelectric Material
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A new finite element model, the hybrid Trefftz finite element method (HT-FEM), is proposed for transversely isotropic piezoelectric materials. In this paper, the main research object is piezoelectric ceramics. The materials is transversely isotropic in nature. The main idea is to treat displacement and potential as potential problems in a broad sense. Then, the basic solutions satisfying the governing equations of piezoelectric materials are obtained by using Laplace equation, and finally use HT-FEM to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Study on Influence of Lubricating Oil Parameters on Lubrication Characteristics of Ship Stern Bearing
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to reduce the friction and wear of low speed and heavy load sliding bearing and the high temperature phenomenon of stern bearing during sailing, a mathematical model of fluid lubrication between stern shaft and stern bearing was established. Using the rotor bearing system analysis software DLAP (dynamic lubrication analysis program), to solve the Reynolds equation and sticky temperature equation. The influence of oil inlet temperature and inlet pressure on maximum oil film pressure, minimum oil film thickness, temperature rise, power consumption and flow rate between stern shaft and stern bearing are obtained. The results show that the inlet pressure has a great influence on the maximum oil film pressure, minimum film thickness and flow rate. The inlet pressure can be controlled appropriately, which provides a basis for further analysis of lubrication characteristics of stern bearing under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Optimization of Subway Vehicle Interior Structure-Borne Noise Based on Nodal Contribution Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: During the operation of subway, the panels of the vehicle vibrate under external excitation. The radiation noise from the vibration of the panels is the main source of the interior structure-borne noise in low frequency domain. In this paper, the nodal contribution analysis method is used to calculate the influence of the nodes on the peak value of the sound pressure level in the vehicle. The peak sound pressure level of the vehicle interior noise is optimized by modifying the equivalent thickness of the local panels. After reducing the equivalent thickness of some floor panels to 17 mm, the peak value of the radiated noise of each field point generally decreases 2-5 dB. The results show that the nodal contribution analysis is effective when calculating the nodes that contribute the most to the interior noise of the vehicle. And the targeted optimization method which considers the characteristics of car body structure can improve the structure-borne noise level in the vehicle.

articleTitle: Research on Absolute Distance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Using frequency sweep interference to measure distance, which is an effective new method. In the process of theoretical derivation, this paper is based on the principle of interference of light to establish a functional relationship between distance and phase. In the ranging experiment, an overall ranging experiment system was built, which based on theoretical principles. When collecting experimental signals, it is considered that the experiment is electronic interference rather than optical interference, and the electronic device is used to modulate the signal. In the signal processing, the FFT transform method is used to calculate the ranging distance, and a large number of experimental data are analyzed. The data shows that the experiment is within the error tolerance.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling of Quayside Container Crane and Its Vibration Characteristic Analysis under Hoisting Condition
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to study the dynamic characteristics of quayside container crane hoisting system, a simplified mechanical model and a mathematical model of quayside container crane are established based on the finite element pre-analysis. Besides, a dynamic model of quayside container crane hoisting system under the excitation of wire rope retracting displacement is established. Taking a certain type of quayside container crane as the research object, the whole hoisting dynamic process of the quayside container crane system is simulated, and the dynamic response of the quayside container crane during the hoisting process is obtained by numerical method. The hoisting condition is divided into two stages and the transient analysis is carried out. At the same time, the different rope-retracting speeds are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Lifetime Distribution Model for Mechanical Product
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The fault regularity reflects the failure probability of mechanical product at a specific time. Usually, it conforms to a certain mathematical distribution form through model identification. According to the mathematical distribution form, the reliability indicators of product can be calculated and the product lifetime can be predicted. Therefore, accurately finding the fault regularity of mechanical product and further precisely identifying its mathematical distribution form is the key to study product reliability. In this paper, a new and high precision model identification technique is used to study the lifetime distribution form for mechanical product. Proved by actual test data of vehicle reliability, it is help to improve the identification accuracy of lifetime distribution model for mechanical product.

articleTitle: Research on Grinding Mechanism of Wall-Climbing Grinding Robot for Large Spherical Tank
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The structural integrity of spherical tanks is very important. Weld grinding is a significantly necessary preparation of the non-destructive testing. Due to the need for scaffolding, poor operating conditions and low grinding efficiency, manual grinding has become an undesirable method of weld grinding, and automated inspection techniques are preferred for using in weld grinding. In order to improve the grinding efficiency of welds, the present work introduced an automatic wall-climbing grinding robot technology according to the grinding process requirements of the spherical tank wall. The design requirements and device structure component of the grinding robot were analyzed. A visualized wall-climbing grinding robot adopting a swing-arm mechanism was designed and tested by comparing the grinding performance of different grinding head mechanisms. The weld grinding results shows that the designed wall-climbing grinding robot has good grinding performance, which effectively improves the automation level of the weld grinding.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Oil-Filling Characteristics of DCT Clutch System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The wet dual clutch transmission (DCT) controls clutch engagement and disengagement by charging and releasing hydraulic oil into the clutch oil pressure chamber. The pressure oil is filled into the clutch chamber, and the clutch is engaged; otherwise, the clutch is disconnected. The speed of clutch dynamic oil-filling time has a significant influence on the realization of DCT shift control law, vehicle starting performance, shifting smoothness and other shifting quality. In this paper, taking a DCT clutch system with the proportional solenoid valve (PSV) as the research object, the operation principle of the DCT clutch system is introduced, and the dynamic oil-filling characteristics of the clutch are studied by experiment on the hydraulic control unit (HCU) test bench. Finally, a method for optimizing the structure of clutch oil circuit is proposed, and the dynamic oil-filling characteristics of the clutch are compared and verified on the HCU test bench. The optimized structure can effectively improve the dynamic oil-filling performance of the DCT clutch system.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Electromagnetic Vibration of Rotor Compressor Motor Based on Modal Superposition Method
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to study the electromagnetic vibration of the inverter compressor motor, a 6-pole 9-slot permanent magnet synchronous motor is taken as the research object. Firstly, the radial electromagnetic force wave generated by the air gap magnetic field of the motor under sine wave power supply is obtained by analytical method. Order and frequency distribution, and obtain the transient electromagnetic force on the stator core through electromagnetic software, simulate the modal of the motor stator assembly, obtain the low-order radial mode shape and frequency of the motor, and on this basis, we combines the electromagnetic force with the motor modal mesh to obtain the radial vibration response of the stator surface of the motor by modal superposition method, and conducts a bench test under the corresponding working conditions of the motor to measure the vibration spectrum of the motor. The results show that the simulation results are in good agreement with the test results, and the analysis process has important reference significance for predicting the electromagnetic vibration of different types of compressor motors.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Mechanical Seal Water Joint Failure
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For the leakage of a mechanical seal water joint, the Six Sigma tool method is used to analyze the fault phenomenon, and the bearing support coaxiality, mechanical seal structural parameters, auxiliary seal design and mechanical seal spring specific pressure are the key factors causing leakage; the relevance of key factors is analyzed, the direction of improvement is determined. The theoretical basis for the leakage is further determined by simulation calculation; the calculation result can also guide the subsequent optimization design. The improved water joint has been verified by mounting and testing.

articleTitle: Abnormal Exposure Image Self-Adaptive Correction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the process of taking photos, there are often cases where the photo is not properly exposed: such as overexposure or underexposure, a large amount of information and details cannot be displayed on the photo in the event of an abnormally exposed photo. In order to self-adaptively correct the abnormal exposure image, an Abnormal exposure image self-adaptive correction algorithm is proposed. Firstly, by first measuring the brightness of the scene of the image and comparing it with the brightness threshold that we have measured in advance, the exposure state of the image is judged. Secondly, overexposure and underexposure correction are respectively performed according to different states, and finally the normal exposure state is synthesized. image. It is proved by experiments that the algorithm can self-adaptively judge the exposure state of the image and can perform different exposure state corrections.

articleTitle: Design and Research of the Load Device for Simulating the Product on the Rocket Based on the Finite Element Life Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Simulation load equipment of aerospace electromechanical servo system is a simulation load equipment of acceptance test and verification electromechanical servo system. Load equipment simulates load and inertia and hinge moment by adding inertia block and spring plate which is driven by repeated torsion motion, so that the spring plate has the risk of fatigue fracture. The time node of fatigue damage of spring steel plate is given based on the fatigue life loading model and finite element life simulation analysis, which provides the theoretical basis for the actual use of simulated load and the basis for the design of simulated load of electromechanical servo system. According to the fatigue damage time of spring steel plate calculated in the paper, replace new spring steel plate to prevent casualties and damage of personnel and equipment.

articleTitle: Multi-UAV Cooperative Detection Method for Ballistic Missile Boosting Section
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: For the cooperative detection of the long-range ballistic missile boosting segment, a multi-UAV cooperative detection method was proposed based on the dual-UAV cooperative detection, which combines the tentative maneuvering trajectory optimization with the triaxial separation IMM-EKF (TASIMM-EKF) filtering algorithm. Firstly, considering the influence of the position of the drones on the target positioning accuracy, the tentative maneuvering trajectory optimization strategy was proposed for the trajectory optimization of each detecting drone. At the same time, a three-axis separation IMM-EKF filtering algorithm was proposed. The simulation results show the proposed method can improve the state estimation accuracy effectively, shorten the estimation time, and have good performance for maneuvering target state estimation. It provides theoretical guidance and technical support for the next study of interception problems.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Impact Factors of Auxiliary Bearing in Vertical Magnetic Bearing
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Auxiliary bearing is used to support the high-speed falling rotor in the active magnetic bearing. Its impact resistance directly affects the safety and reliability of the active magnetic bearing. In order to study the impact resistance of the auxiliary bearing in the vertical active magnetic bearing, full angular contact hybrid ceramic ball bearing was used as the auxiliary bearing, and ADAMS was used to simulate the impact force of the auxiliary bearing when the balanced rotor was fell on the auxiliary bearing. The influence of friction factor, axial protection clearance, rotor mass and rotor drop speed on the initial axial impact force of the vertical balanced rotor falling to the auxiliary bearing is analyzed. The results show that the initial axial impact force on the auxiliary bearing is the maximum axial impact force. The initial axial impact force on the protected bearing decreases with the increase of dynamic friction factor. It increases with the increase of axial protection clearance and rotor mass. Unchanged with the increase of falling speed. The influence of axial impact on the bearing can be reduced by increasing the friction factor, reducing the clearance of axial protection and the mass of rotor appropriately.

articleTitle: Design and Test of Core Components of Two-Plane Rotary Knot
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In view of the complex structure, manufacturing difficulties and low reliability of the current domestic knott, a two-plane rotary knotting device is designed. This paper describes in detail the design structure of the core components of the knottor. The experiment showed that the junction success rate of the two-plane rotary knotting device was 92%. The knottor has simple structure, low cost and high reliability, which meets the agricultural requirements of farmers on the knotting of grass bales.

articleTitle: Thermal and Structural Analysis of the Nuclear Explosive Device
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The nuclear explosive device (NED) is the core part of the nuclear weapons, therefore, it needs strict mechanical and structural capabilities. This paper modifies the model raised by Steve Fetter by fixing the NED with spherical supports according to its manufacture needs in industry. With such modified model, the paper obtains the heat producing power of Weapon-grade Plutonium (WgPu) at first which is the heat producing material in the fissional layer. Then, the paper analyzes the thermal characteristics and a transient simulation is carried out to make clear the temperature distribution with the finite element method, and time for the temperature field to be stable after the NED being equipped is known. Furthermore, the paper studies the possible contact behaviors between components of the NED. With the contact behaviors being given, structural and thermo-structural characteristics of the NED in storage are clear with the simulation respectively. At last, the calculated results and usability of the raised model are discussed and a conclusion of the existence of the modified NED model in real world is drawn.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Energy Separation in Vortex Tube with Various Nozzles
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The 3D models of vortex tube with straight nozzle, zoom nozzle and Archimedes nozzle were established. SST k-ω turbulence model was used for numerical simulation. The working fluid was air with inlet pressure of 0.4 Mpa and inlet temperature of 285K. The temperature difference between hot and cold exit and the coefficient of refrigeration and heating about different nozzle structures was compared. The vortex chamber velocity and the axial velocity distribution of the internal flow field were analyzed when the cold mass fraction was 0.37. The results concluded in this paper proved that different nozzle structures had great influence on energy separation performance.

articleTitle: Workspace Analysis of CNC Load-Unload Material Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A 2P3R robot for CNC load-unload material was designed in self-creating. In the paper, the kinematics equation was established by D-H method. The mathematical model of robot pedestal, member bar and end effector was established. By numerical analysis method and collision detection algorithm, the workspace was analyzed and the collision-free cloud chart of pedestal, member bar and end effecter was got. These are theoretical basis for the robot control and path planning. The method is simple and intuitionistic, and pinpoint robot workspace edge was acquired. It has some reference value for other robot mechanism kinematics and workspace analysis.

articleTitle: Accurate Prediction Method for Energy Consumption in Automatic Tool Changing Process of Computer Numerical Control Lathe
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to achieve accurate prediction of energy consumption in the automatic tool change process of Computer Numerical Control (CNC) lathe and provide a basic model for energy saving optimization of CNC lathe, an accurate prediction method is proposed for energy consumption in the automatic tool changing process for computer numerical control lathe. The method firstly measures the duration of automatic tool changing under multiple sets of rotary cutters by fitting the measured value. The energy consumption of the basic module of the machine tool is obtained by calculating the measured value which is based on the basic module power of the machine tool and the duration of the automatic tool changing. And the steady state energy consumption of the tool changer is obtained by calculating the measured value. By obtaining the energy consumption caused by all the power peaks in the automatic tool changing process of CNC lathe, the transient state energy consumption of the tool changer is got. The whole energy consumption is consisted of the basic module of the machine tool, the steady state of the tool changer and the transient state of the tool changer. Finally, a case study of energy modelling and analysis for a CK6153i CNC lathe finds that the prediction accuracy is above 95%, which indicates that the research can accurately predict the energy consumption of the CNC lathe in the tool changing process.

articleTitle: Polynomial Fitting Based Vibration Prediction and Stabilization Control of a 6 Degree-of-Freedom Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Many researchers aim at modifying control algorithm to improve the stabilization performance. However, the lag time between the vibration data collecting and the output of the system makes a big difference in the control process. In this paper, a 6 Degree-of-Freedom parallel platform is implemented to isolate the vibration caused by the carrier. A polynomial fitting based prediction approach is proposed to advance the vibration signal phase, and then improve the stabilization performance. Firstly, the platform is introduced and modeled by in-verse, forward kinematic analyzing. Secondly, the polynomial fitting base prediction approach is proposed. Finally, the actuator control and the stabilization control method are introduced, and verified by a Simulink model.

articleTitle: CFD Analysis of Supercritical CO2 Turbine Shaft Supporting Device
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the fluid dynamics analysis software Fluent, a three-dimensional model of the turbine main shaft supporting device was established, and numerical analysis of fluid domain in the device have been carried out. Simulation analysis was carried out for the gas film under different inlet pressures and different spindle speeds. The distribution law of pressure field inside the gas film is obtained, and the variation trend of bearing capacity is compared and analyzed. The results show that the <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sub>CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas film pressure in the device and supporting capacity increase with the increase of the supply pressure and the rotation speed. Moreover, under extremely high speed operating conditions, the dynamic pressure effect of the gas film inside the supporting device is particularly obvious.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Clamping Clamp of the Transplanter
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel and innovative jaw-type transplanting mechanism. It can perform the movement of the transplanting jaws by telescopic cylinders. This mechanism can improve the transplanting efficiency, and reduce the damage to the seedlings in the nursery during the transplanting process. It is composed of a semi-circular extension slot and a transplanting jaw, and these two parts form a circular ring that pulls the nursery in the seedling tray out of the lifting cylinder. The nursery is analyzed by using finite element analysis method. The result shows that the maximum stress of the nursery is 2447 Pa and the maximum strain is 1.536×10-8 when the transplanting jaw was taken 25 mm from the top of the nursery. This moment the stressed and strained of the nursery is subjected to the least. In this case, the diameter of the nursery clip taken by the transplanting jaw is 60 mm, and thus the bending radius of the jaw is 60 mm.

articleTitle: GPS/SINS Speed Integral Matching Alignment Based on Improved Adaptive UKF
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To solve the problem of system error and environmental interference of MEMS inertial sensor, which make SINS cannot quickly and accurately alignment, a GPS/SINS speed "integral" matching alignment method is designed. Firstly, the GPS velocity measurement values are used to assits the SINS for coarse alignment in this paper. Then, speed integral matching fine alignment is performed. Establishing the alignment model, the solution speed of the SINS is corrected by the least squares curve fitting method and the arm effect is compensated for the GPS speed signal before filtering. Using the unscented Kalman filter (UKF) and the improved adaptive UKF to achieve the fine alignment respectively. Outdoor experiments and simulation's results show that the improved adaptive UKF can achieve higher alignment accuracy and speed. Compared with the common UKF, the accuracy of the east, north and up misalignment angles is inhanced by 0.12°, 0.03° and 0.19°, respectively. The alignment time is shortened by 20s, 10s and 25s, respectively. The above work can provide a reference for AUV accurate navigation.

articleTitle: Structural Design and Finite Element Analysis of Desktop Stacking Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of industrial robot, its structure stability, accuracy and reliability are more and more demanding. Therefore, a four degree of freedom desktop stacking manipulator is designed, and the base, big arm and forearm of the manipulator are checked and optimized. In addition, the strength and stiffness are verified to meet the requirements through finite element analysis, which improves the safety and stability, and realizes the operation requirements of grasping, handling and placing different goods.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Baffle Number on Liquid Sloshing Characteristics in Tank
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Due to the increased transportation demand, the stability and safety of the tank structure caused by liquid sloshing has also attracted more attention. This paper establishes a 3D model and creates a numerical model based on the VOF method. The effects of the number of vertical baffles on the sloshing characteristics, such as waveform changes, flow field distribution, and sloshing pressure, were investigated. The results show that the greater the number of vertical partitions, the better the damping effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Thermodynamic Analysis of Ultrashort Laser Pulses Acting on the Silver
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper discusses the application of laser processing technology in machining industry so as to further improve the progress and quality of machining. A two-temperature model of silver is established based on the COMSOL simulation software. The effects of spot radius and laser energy on the temperatures of electron and lattice are numerically investigated via the control of variables, and thus the ablation morphology is predicted. Because of its non-contact andreal-time characteristics, ultrashort laser has been used more and more in the processing and testing of silver. In this paper, the electronic and lattice temperatures of silver with different laser pulse widths are calculated by using double temperature model with the help of finite element analysis software. The results show that the pulse width of laser will affect the material., the peak value of electron temperature and the coupling time of electron lattice.

articleTitle: Quantitative Study on the Humping Formation Mechanism of GMAW with Consideration of Varying Viscosity in Molten Pool
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: There is no unified understanding about the mechanism of hump weld bead. Research on the internal relationship between humping formation and the viscosity of molten pool is still lack of study. The numerical simulation method is used to study the mechanism quantitatively by considering the changing viscosity, which is mainly determined by temperature and the content of alloy elements. The results show that viscosity is an important factor affecting temperature and pressure fields. In addition, temperature field determines the existence of hump, pressure field determines the size of the hump. Four weld parameters like boundary temperature, welding moving speed, welding power and alloy element content in molten pool have significant effects on humping formation, which are discussed emphatically. All effects are positive. Finally, an experiment is designed to verify the simulation well.

articleTitle: Research on the Flow Field Characteristics of a Wheat Flour Purifier Based on the Standard Turbulent Model
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The wheat flour purifier is one of the most important equipment in the process of making wheat flour. In this paper, the flow field characteristics of a wheat flour purifier were analyzed with four different air duct structures under two levels of air amount. The effects of the duct size on the velocity and pressure of the air in a wheat flour purifier were discussed. The analysis was conducted with the method of computational fluid dynamics based on the standard turbulent model. Results showed that the duct size had significant effects on the homogeneity of the wind in the wheat flour purifier. Two open ends and a proper combination of the duct size would make the wind more homogeneous.

articleTitle: Analyses and Application of Conductor's Tension Stringing Layout for Large-Angle Turning
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: When a transmission line in a power transmission project is to be constructed in a high mountain (range), it's difficult to choose a site for the tension and traction fields of earth wires. A conductor must turn at a large angle after going out of the tension field, since the tension and traction fields cannot be set right below the line due to terrain and traffic constraints. This paper includes analyses of multi-block plane positional relationships for the case of large-angle turning, based on the construction of the Sichuan Ya'an II-Ziyang circuit 500-kV line transmission and transformation project, then a study of multi-block spatial positional attitude and calculations of the spatial forces upon the blocks, on the basis of multi-block plane layout, and finally analyses of the siting and layout of the turning field in tension stringing, suggesting a standard procedure for turning field layout according to the guidelines and practical engineering experience.

articleTitle: Cross Fracture Simulation Based on Cohesive Element
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the theory of rock mechanics and fracture mechanics, the hydraulic crack and natural crack are set by Cohesive element, the finite element software ABAQUS is used to set up a two-dimensional model of cross-crack propagation, which is based on fluid-solid coupling. The target mesh is locally encrypted according to the crack fracturing and propagating position, and the near boundary uses a larger mesh density, which can control the calculation accuracy and reduce the calculation time. The model is used to analyze the influence of different stress difference and the angle between natural crack and maximum horizontal stress on the intersection of cracks. The results show that when the ground stress difference is small, the hydraulic crack will crack along the natural crack. When the stress difference is large, the hydraulic crack will extend along the direction of the maximum horizontal principal stress; when the angle between the natural crack and the maximum horizontal ground stress is small, the hydraulic crack extends along the direction of the natural crack. When the angle is large, the hydraulic crack directly penetrates the natural crack and extends along the direction of the maximum horizontal principal stress.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Simulation Analysis of a Discharge Blade in Coating Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The coating machine is key equipment in the food and pharmaceutical industry. This paper designs a kind of discharge blade for discharge of a coating machine. The proposed blade is composed of two sections, and they are installed inside a coating cylinder. In addition, the angle between the first blade and the horizontal plane has an influence on the discharging effect. This paper takes the discharge blade as the research object to study the discharge effect and we set five sets of angle data, then comparing the discharge effect under different angles through EDEM simulation analysis. The results show that the tablets could be completely discharged by discharge blade, the discharging time is about 20 minutes at 8 rpm, and the best angle of discharge blade is 55°. This discharge blade can be applied to actual production, and it can provide a reference for the development of coating machines.

articleTitle: Similarity Query Method for Time Series Subsequences Based on Pathologic Matching of DTW
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Time series of fuzzy concept with random noise and complex deformation cause the difficulty of subsequence similarity query. To solve the problems of subsequence query, a similarity query method for time series subsequences based on pathologic matching of DTW is proposed. Firstly, boundary curves are built up and down by using query sequence sample sets. Lower bounding distance based on the sequence of samples is proposed with a proof correctness to build lower bounding algorithm for filtrating subsequences to increase efficiency. Then, the invalid subsequence field is recognized and deleted for determining the valid subsequence field of matching by pathologic matching of DTW. The results of experiments prove that the proposed method can quickly and accurately find similarity subsequences.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Effect of Fuel Preheating Temperature on Temperature Field and NOx Emission of 130kW Natural Gas Heater
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Green development is one of the important trends of energy development and transformation in the world. Natural gas as a clean energy, its related application equipment research will play a very important role in green development. In order to study the influence of different fuel preheating temperature on the temperature field and NOx emission in 130kW natural gas heater, DO radiation model, standard k - ϵ model, non premixed combustion model, thermal and prompt NOx model are used to simulate the thermal flow field in the heater. The results show that with the increase of fuel preheating temperature, the heat release from combustion, the average temperature of fire tube and flue tube bundle and the outlet temperature of convective tube bundle increase first and then decrease, and the maximum flame temperature and NOx emission increase continuously. After comprehensive analysis, the optimum preheating temperature of the fuel imported from the burner is 800K. At this temperature, the heat release from combustion, the average temperature of fire tube and flue tube bundle and the outlet temperature of convective tube bundle are the highest, and the rate of NOx formation begins to decrease.

articleTitle: Study on Molding Rate with Segmented Control in Glass Molding Process
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and electro-optical communication industry, the demand for aspherical glass lens is increasing in the high-precision imaging. Molding rate with segmented control technology in the glass molding process (MRSC-GMP) was proposed to fabricate aspehrical lens in this paper. Based on the generalized Maxwell model, finite element simulation was used to analyze the residual stress, and compared with the conventional single-step glass molding process (GMP). The residual stress of the molded lens in MRSC-GMP is smaller than that in IGMP, which is beneficial to the service life of molded lens.

Author Keywords: aspherical lens, glass molding process, segmented control, residual stress

articleTitle: Analysis of Abnormal Problem of Low Temperature Working Resistance of a Radar Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The abnormal working resistance of the transmission system at low temperature often affects the normal operation of the radar. This paper analyzes the abnormal problem of low temperature working torque of a radar transmission system, and summarizes the nine influencing factors of the abnormality of low temperature resistance. The problem location and mechanism analysis are given. The solution was verified and verified by experiments. The research results and analysis methods of this case have guiding significance for solving similar faults.

articleTitle: Precision Assembly System Based on Position-Orientation Decoupling Design
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Automatic precision assembly, as an alternative to manually assembly, is plays an important role in small complex device fabrication. For irregular shape components assembly, it is difficult to realize both positon and orientation adjustment. In this paper, an automatic system to assembly pendulous component to base is designed and developed. The design strategy is reassembling the human's left and right hand. The pendulous component is adsorbed by the adsorption head which is driven by an X-Y-Z linear stage. The base is screw mounted on the feeding platform, and the orientation is adjusted by an X-Y-Z rotary stage. The two mechanisms collaborated to conduct the threading and flip actions, after that, two grippers hold the pendulous fiber and move in opposite direction to apply tension force. In the measurement process, the position - orientation decoupling also brings the benefit of change the measurement direction from parallel to the perpendicular surface of the camera, which make the system compacted. The decoupling of the position and orientation adjustment made the control and calibration of the assembly simplified as well as promotes the assembly accuracy.

Author Keywords: Automatic precision assembly, position-orientation decoupling, tension force, accuracy

articleTitle: Manipulator Arm Interactive Control in Unknown Underwater Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of robot technology, robots nowadays are gradually used in complex or inaccessible environments. Usually robots are program controlled to execute grabbing tasks, which however has many limits, especially in the underwater environment. In this paper an interactive manipulator arm control system based on 3D vision sensor in unknown underwater environment is introduced. The operator's arm action can be mapped to the manipulator arm through a virtual manipulator arm on a computer screen. The spatial position of object can be determined through the underwater vision sensor which is mounted on the manipulator arm. The manipulator arm approaches and grabs the object by recognizing and mapping the joint angles received from operator's arm. In this process, the virtual manipulator arm and underwater scene with object are displayed on the interactive interface and meanwhile the operator can analyze the environment situation and make a global decision for manipulator arm's further action. The results corroborate the validity of the proposed approach for manipulator arm control.

articleTitle: Model Build and Optimization Design on Powder Compaction
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming at the delamination of bricks in powder compacting process, causes of delamination and force analysis on powder compaction are studied. Meanwhile, a mathematics model is established. Based on this model, a measure to reduce the delamination is proposed: increase the compressing velocity and pressure and decrease the raising velocity and height. The sequence of these influential factors is analyzed by orthogonal test. The correctness of the model is verified in the test and a best parameter combination has been put forward. The quality of production and production efficiency can be ensured in the powder compaction.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Oil Mist Lubrication and Residual Fog Recovery
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As a more efficient and advanced technology, adapting oil mist lubrication system as the leading lubricating plan has become a trend in enterprises. This paper summarizes and discusses the development of oil mist lubrication system and key technologies of it. At the same time, in order to solve the residual fog overflow problem of oil mist lubrication system, the various methods of residual fog recovery are summarized and discussed. Meanwhile, the future direction about the development of residual fog recovery system is prospected based on the current situation.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Feedrate Planning of NURBS Curves for CNC System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In CNC machining, non-uniform rational B-spline (NURBS) curve is commonly used to describe the tool path for machining complex curves and surfaces. In order to improve the machining accuracy of NURBS curve, it is necessary to control the feedrate under geometric and kinematic constraints throughout the machining process. This paper proposes a segmental adaptive feedrate planning algorithm with low allowable feedrate at critical sub-curves and high allowable feedrate at regular sub-curves, which makes a balance between interpolation precision and efficiency. To solve the remaining distance problem caused by the contradiction between continuous feedrate planning and periodic interpolation as well as the nonlinear relationship between arc length and parameters, this paper calculates step-length using displacement-time function on every interpolation period and proposes a step-length correcting algorithm at the intersection of two adjacent sub-curves. The simulation results show that smooth motion under the chord-error and kinematic constraints can be obtained within curves with sharp curvature variation throughout the interpolation process, which validate the advantages of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring and Dynamic Analysis of Quayside Container Crane
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: It is necessary to obtain the dynamic characteristics of the quayside container crane for the health monitoring of its structure system. Different working conditions will bring different dynamic characteristics. Considering the complexity of the connection boundary condition simulation of large construction machinery, this paper uses the stiffness element MATRIX27 to simulate the connection condition of the quayside container crane. Then, based on the finite element model of the crane, combined with the selected specific monitoring positions, the dynamic characteristics of the quayside container crane are analyzed considering the normal operation and the eccentric load operation. It is concluded that the eccentric load of the crane will have a greater impact on the speed and acceleration response of the traveling direction of the crane. However, it has a smaller impact on the stress distribution and the wheel pressure of the crane. The above results also provide a basis for the selection of the specific content of health monitoring.

articleTitle: Obstacle Surmounting Principle Analysis and Structural Design for Two Degree of Freedom Tracked Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces a variable crawler robot based on the triangular configuration, and analyzes its obstacle mechanism. With the control variable method, it focuses on the obstacle mechanism of the crawler robot and the change of the center of gravity during the obstacle crossing process. In addition, the three-dimensional modeling of the overall structure of the crawler robot is also carried out, and the stiffness of the key mechanism is checked to verify the feasibility of the scheme design. It can provide some reference value for those who study the crawler robot.

articleTitle: Research on the Adjustable Magnification of Vision Measurement Module Integrated in Precision Assembly System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To satisfy the demand of multi-scale measurement of miniature parts, a vision measurement module with zoom lenses was set up for evaluation and final integration in precision assembly system. A new template with circular patterns of different diameters was designed for calibration of zoom-lens camera. The principal point was determined based on the focus-of-expansion method, and the orientational deviation of image was experimentally studied in the zoom process. Pixel equivalent was calculated by circular patterns of different diameters and its repeatability was tested during the zoom process. Experimental results indicated that the principal point offset is less than 0.6pixel, and the measurement error caused by orientational deviation of image is negligible for most of the assembly tasks. Due to the good repeatability of pixel equivalent, off-line calibration data can be used in the actual measurement process. When the much higher accuracy was required during assembly, the online calibration could be employed.

articleTitle: Error Analysis of the Geometric Self-Calibration of the Grating Interferometer System for the Wafer Stage
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Geometric self-calibration of the grating interferometer system is essential to improve the displacement measurement accuracy of the wafer stage, and the error analysis is critical for geometric self-calibration. The self-calibration idea based on the self-consistency of a redundant system and the step-by-step self-calibration method of the grating interferometer system for the wafer stage are briefly introduced. The error sources destroying the self-consistency of the geometric mathematical model are analyzed and transformed into the phase shift errors caused by non-geometric errors. The relationship between the accuracy of the model after self-calibration and the phase shift errors is established by fitting the simulation data and can be used as a basis for the design and accuracy budget of the self-calibration process of the grating interferometer system for the wafer stage.

articleTitle: Analysis and Synthesis on the Double Feed Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Double feed mechanism refers to the mechanism in which the performing link has two working and return strokes within one cycle of the driving link, it is mainly used in automatic feeding of automatic machine tools. Elliptic crank is a planet mechanism which is able to generate elliptic curve, with elliptic crank as the driven crank of the slider-crank mechanism is equal to the mechanism which has a crank of the varying length and varying speed and moving along the elliptical, which changed the kinematic characteristics of the slider. The III type of the slider elliptic-crank mechanism has properties of double working strokes. In this paper, a special type III mechanism is used as a double feed mechanism. The methods of mechanism analysis and synthesis are presented. The influence of mechanism parameters on each stroke is analyzed. The selection range of mechanism parameters is given. It provides a theoretical basis for the design of double working stroke mechanism.

articleTitle: Energy Saving and Optimal Loading Analysis of Ship Trim
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In this study, the optimum trim of 82,000 DWT bulk carrier is taken as the research object. By adjusting the draught and trim of the ship, the RANS equations are solved by using SST k-ω turbulence model in CFD simulation software Fluent, and the ship navigation resistance at different trim is calculated. The research shows that the resistance of ships varies with different speeds and trim. Adjusting the trim of the ship is a simple and reliable method to reduce the ship resistance. Finally, using ballast tank and cargo tank as control variables, the optimal trim value obtained by CFD calculation is set as the objective function. Under the constraints of ship stability criterion, strength requirement and loading capacity, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is adopted to output the loading scheme, which provides guidance for the energy-saving navigation of bulk carriers.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Manufacturing Digital Workshop Ability Assessment Model for CPS
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the development of intelligent manufacturing, many leading enterprises with international competitiveness have been generated in China. But compared with the enterprises in developed countries, there is still a big gap. Establishing an assessment model and indicator system for the intelligent manufacturing digital workshop by summarizing the practical experiences, common practices and cores of the universal recognition of intelligent manufacturing, which will help enterprises to carry out intelligent manufacturing. However, the current intelligent manufacturing related to assessment methods and models have different degrees of deficiencies, and it is necessary to carry out assessment methods and models for the core elements of intelligent manufacturing based on CPS. This paper extracts 16 core elements of the intelligent manufacturing, establishes the assessment model using the correlation and comprehensive weighting method, applies model into different industries, and provides a new idea for the formation of the industry-wide intelligent manufacturing assessment model.

Author Keywords: intelligent manufacturing, core elements, assessment model, CPS, comprehensive weighting

articleTitle: Parametric Design and Optimization of Eight-Bar Mechanism Based on RecurDyn
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper takes the closed eight-bar mechanism in large tonnage punching press as the study object. The geometric dimensions of the mechanism were optimized and designed on the basis of three design requirements of slider total stroke, maximum stretching depth and maximum stretching speed in effective tension process. The parametric model of the mechanism was built in the RecurDyn environment, and the displacement curve and velocity curve were obtained through the kinematic simulation. Based on the displacement curve, the slider total stroke was calculated. Based on the velocity curve and the maximum stretching speed requirement in the process of effective tension, the available maximum stretching depth was calculated and the dimension parameters of the mechanism were gained at last. The optimization results show that the available maximum stretching depth increased by 39% while the total length of eight bars remains unchanged.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization Genetic Algorithm for Flow-Shop Scheduling Module by Using Fuzzy-AHP
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Scheduling problem is a multi-objective optimization problem. Genetic algorithms (GAs) have showed the ability of finding near optimal solutions for flow-shop scheduling problems. The infection of delivery time delay, machine efficiency, employee overtime and other criteria should be considered. Because the ERP system realizes the production process management of the enterprise, data mining method could be used to find effective information in system. This paper improves the ordinary genetic algorithm and designs a multi-optimization flow-shop scheduling algorithm by using fuzzy-AHP. It also gives an example that proved it was feasible and effective approach method.

Author Keywords: Flow-shop, Genetic Algorithms, AHP (analytic hierarchy process)

articleTitle: Research on Safety Collision Technology for Micro/Nano Satellite Robot Assembly
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the process of modern industrial production, there are many assembly processes for components, especially the assembly of equipment for aerospace Micro/Nano satellite products, which is usually characterized by many processes and complex processes, and the efficiency of traditional manual operation is low. It is difficult to finish the process with high assembly precision by hand, and the assembly quality of components is easy to be affected by man-made factors. Based on the better dexterity of the light-weight humanoid manipulator, the system construction scheme of the dual-arm cooperative assembly robot is summarized in this paper. The whole-body coordinate system is established and the Jacobian matrix of the whole-body is derived according to the architecture of the two-arm cooperative robot with redundant degrees of freedom. In view of the shared workspace between robots and human beings, and the possibility of accidental collision with human beings, this paper studies the collision control strategy of robots, and makes a preliminary research on collision problems from the point of view of dynamics. The collision function and the collision recognition vector are defined to judge whether the robot collides or not. Then the reaction mechanism of the robot to the collision is given and the safety control strategy is formed. Finally, the application idea of dual-arm cooperative robot in the assembly of Micro/Nano satellite equipment components is described.

articleTitle: Research on Accuracy of Heave Data Test System for Inertial Navigation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of the heave data test system of the inertial navigation device of the pull-line displacement sensor structure, a model correction method is proposed to correct the output data of the system. By drafting scatter plots of the error data and the sensor output data, a linear relationship is found between the two, and then the least squares method is used to solve the equations to work out the coefficients of the modified model. Finally, the modified model is applied to the test system, and the modified test system gets verified by the experimental results showing that the error values generated from the corrected test system are significantly lower than the one from the original test system, hence the accuracy of the test system gets improved.

articleTitle: Kinematics Analysis of a Novel Continuum Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: This paper presents a novel wire-driven continuum picking manipulator which own the hollow structure for transporting the object along its internal space, such as harvesting the fruits, conveying liquid. In order to map the motion of the manipulator, the kinematics, instantaneous kinematics and workspace are analyzed. In addition, the kinematic performance with different posture is discussed based on dexterity index by Jacobian matrix decomposition. Further, several typical trajectories are experimented based the inverse kinematics in different region of workspace. The results demonstrated that the wire-driven continuum picking manipulator own favorable motion performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Standard of Intelligent Production Line Level
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Based on the basic structure of the intelligent production line, the indicator hierarchy is established according to the basic ideas of the analytic hierarchy process; combining its intelligent features, we can complete the extraction and screening of indicators at each level. The expert consultation method is used to construct the judgment matrix for various indicators under the same level, and the consistency test is completed. The weight of each index is determined by the eigenvalue method. Finally, according to the intelligent manufacturing capability maturity model, the scoring rules and comprehensive calculation models of each indicator are formulated, and the evaluation of the total target score is completed. Compared with the score range of the intelligent level, we can judge the level of the intelligent level of the production line at the present stage, and analyze the development direction and improvement measures in the later stage.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Power Data Collection Node
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: In the process of industrial production, it is often necessary to collect various kinds of data to assist production. Data is usually generated by various sensors, encapsulated by the collection node, and sent to the data center for storage and analyzing. The number of sensors in a manufacturing system is large, as well as the data collection nodes accordingly. These data collection nodes pose great challenges to energy saving. This article describes a design of a low-power data collection node that can be widely used for data collection and transmission. To fully reduce the power consumption of data transmission, which is the most significant part of the total power consumption, we designed the ultra-low power data transceiver constructed by low-voltage discrete devices working at the 1.8V voltage. The power consumption of other parts of the node is also optimized. As a result, the overall power consumption is less than 80mW when the data rate is 2Mbps. The low-power collection node can be connected to any sensor that generates a digital signal. Low power consumption and reliable features make it suitable for large-scale and complex production environments.

Author Keywords: data collection node, low power consumption, data transceiver

articleTitle: Handling Device for Long Cargo: Innovative Design and Emulational Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Handling device have been widely used for Factory and warehouse applications such as working High temperature and toxic environments. Similar device have also been applied to Palletizing processes. These types of devices were considered during the design of the early warehouse. Studies have looked at the handling device for box-type goods but there are not any emulational and experimental studies on Long strip cargo. Understanding the role of Movement principle of the link mechanism and its Kinematic equation is key to the Design of handling device. This study presents emulational and experimental results of a Handling device carry long strip cargo. We used Adams, an Automatic Dynamic Analysis of Mechanical Systems software for computational studies of the Linkage action. There is tiny discrepancy between our computational and emulational results.

articleTitle: Accurate Reasoning of Assembly Processes Using Unified-Format Planning Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: As key direction to operators who conduct assembly activities, assembly process could be quickly generated based on planning knowledge. However, the assembly process still always lacks of accuracy due to inaccurate reusing cases or paradigms recommended by planning knowledge. In order to solve the problem, this paper proposes to model planning knowledge with properties of components, link relations and annotations directly, to define different kinds of planning knowledge in unified format and to accomplish reasoning of assembly process step by step by following given workflow. An example is shown to prove feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Interior Noise Distribution Characteristics of Metro in Different Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: With the continuous development of urban rail transit, people have higher and higher requirements for comfort during the ride, and the noise level and distribution characteristics are important factors affecting comfort. In this paper, the field test is used to study the noise distribution characteristics in a trailer with a driver's cab, a motor vehicle with pantograph and a motor vehicle without pantograph. The test is carried out at four speeds of 0 km/h, 20 km/h, 40 km/h and 60 km/h, and the A-weighted sound pressure level is used. Through the analysis of the A-weighted equivalent sound pressure level and frequency domain, the distribution law of noise in the metro vehicle can be obtained. The results show that when the speed is from 0 km/h, for every 20 km/h increases, the interior noise of increases by 11.6 dB (A), 1.7 dB (A) and 1.6 dB (A) respectively (taking the measurement point 8 as an example). Each measurement point produces the obvious noise in the low frequency range of 25-50 Hz, and the peak size is between 78.5 dB and 84.5 dB. Interior noise of Tc, Mp, M has different frequency characteristics.

articleTitle: Image Compression Algorithms Based on Dual Tree-Complex Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Aiming to improve the efficiency of image compression on the premise of controlling the compression time, an image compression oriented algorithm is proposed based on Dual Tree-Complex Wavelet and arithmetic coding algorithm.
