Methods : decompose the read-in image by Dt-cwt, then using Wellner (an adaptive binarization method) to calculate the image's threshold. Scan the image by EZW algorithm, and compared the threshold with wavelet coefficients, then output the important coefficients and compress these data by arithmetic coding. Finally, the compressed image was output by encoding inverse transform. Results :Four-level decomposition of Dual Tree-Complex Wavelet and seven-times scanning of the image have better compression result and shorter running time. Conclusion :The hardware configuration of this method is simple, and this algorithm can compress the image with high quality in a short time.

articleTitle: Effects of Friction and Lubrication of New Water-Based Nano-Graphite Lubricant and Application during Warm Extrusion Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A new nano-graphite water-based lubricant, named DN, is presented in this paper. This new lubricant is contrasted with a water-based micro-graphite lubricant, named D1, and a traditional graphite lubricant which has been used in actual forming, named D0. The comparison is done by means of two different friction test methods to assess the friction coefficients and the lubrication effects at warm forming temperatures. Also, a typical automobile steering flange part is chosen for warm extrusion. Both numerical simulation tests and actual forming tests are conducted in order to study the actual friction and lubrication effects of the three test lubricants. Then, the practical applications of the lubricants are studied through the SEM observation of the surface morphology of the formed parts. The test results show that the friction coefficient of the new water-based nano-graphite lubricant is 20% lower than the ordinary lubricant D0, and the friction and lubrication effects are better than that of the micro-graphite lubricant D1. It also shows the excellent lubrication performance during the warm extrusion processing of the test flange part.

articleTitle: Research on Scheduling Strategy of Information Coordination Mechanism for Big Data Storage and Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The scheduling algorithm generally only considers the factors that directly affect the computing performance, such as processor, internal and external storage, and network, but ignores the data itself. In data-intensive computing applications, data deployment takes a long processing time and becomes Restrict the bottleneck of efficiency. In this paper, the data storage and computing information are exchanged and applied reasonably at the right time. A scheduling strategy based on the information coordination mechanism of big data storage and computing is proposed. This strategy makes full use of the advantages of distributed storage, and introduces the replica location into the scheduling parameters. The experimental results are compared with the typical computing capability scheduling strategy, and there are advantages in data preparation time and total operation time.

articleTitle: A Semi Closed Loop Compensation Method for Trajectory Error of Continuum Robot Based on Vector Method
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The complex inverse position solution can be avoided when the continuum robot works in the velocity mode, but the position output error in the velocity mode will have a great impact on the end motion accuracy of the continuum robot. In this paper, from the point of view of servo motor output accuracy, the open-loop drive accuracy is studied based on kinematics. In addition, a position compensator based on vector method is established by using semi closed loop feedback, and its effectiveness is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Quantitative Control of Three-Dimensional Time-Varying Formation for Multi-Rotor Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: A three-dimensional time-varying formation flight control scheme for multi-rotor aircraft based on uniform quantizer is designed. Firstly, the multi-rotor aircraft model with speed command input is established and simplified into a second-order linear model. Secondly, a uniform quantizer is introduced. Based on algebraic graph theory and matrix analysis, a formation tracking control method under fixed topology is proposed. Furthermore, it is proved that the method can make all closed-loop signals globally bounded.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of External Excitation on the Volatilization Characteristics of Oil and Gas in the Cargo Tank of Oil Tanker under Sloshing Condition
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Marine crude oil transportation is the main mode of China's import oil transportation. Marine crude oil storage and transportation is a high-risk operation process. The risk of oil storage and transportation mainly comes from the volatilization of oil and gas. Obviously, controlling the total amount of oil and gas volatilization in the cargo tank of oil tanker is the key link to ensure the safety of storage and transportation. In view of the influence of sloshing frequency and amplitude on the volatile characteristics of oil and gas in the tank of oil tanker during transportation, this paper mainly analyzes the influence of changing sloshing frequency and amplitude on the volatilization characteristics of oil and gas in the tank of oil tanker.

articleTitle: TRIZ-Based Design and Simulation of High Speed End Sealing Device of Packaging Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the end sealing mechanism of the packaging machine in the market, a new high-speed fixed end sealing device is designed based on TRIZ (Theory for Solving Inventive Problems) in this paper. The three-dimensional model of the mechanism was carried on by SolidWorks and the dynamics simulation was carried on by ADAMS. The movement rule of the key components of the end sealing mechanism was obtained through the dynamic analysis. Then the prototype construction and the actual packaging sealing experiment was carried on. The experiment results show that the packaging effect is good and the packaging rate and packaging speed can meet the actual production requirements. It has profound significance to promote the development of packaging machinery and promote packaging automation.

articleTitle: Reliability Design against Catastrophic Failure Caused by Rare Event
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: When a system involves storage, control, usage and transformation of large amounts of energy, failures can have catastrophic consequences. However, ultimate failure is almost always preceded by a chain of events involving multiple factors, including system configuration, coupling behavior, interactions, unexpected feedback loops, weak links, operator errors, random events, common mode failures, and the like. In this paper, the position is taken that no matter how well a system has been designed, failure is inevitable. By thinking in terms of energy and process physics, a new tool to assist in this analysis, the Energy Expansion Tree, is employed to look for opportunities to short circuit the chain of events in such a way as to achieve relatively fail-safe behavior.

articleTitle: Markov Chain and Monte Carlo Predictions for Light Multiple Scattering Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Multiple scattering is considered both an interference source and tentatively the information to measure the optical properties of mediums in many engineering applications, such as fuel spray atomization in IC engines, medical diagnostics for bio-tissues, and atmosphere detection, etc. However, the understanding of multiple scattering is hindered by the stochastic nature of random scattering, especially in the intermediate regime. This work reports a Markov Chain solution to analyze the angular distribution of transmitted photons and compared against a typical method, Monte Carlo algorithm. The Markov Chain method is then utilized to perform an inversion process to derive the optical properties inside the medium and various reconstruction algorithms were tested. Results have shown that Markov Chain method is a viable technique in reducing the computational cost yet preserving the computation fidelity.

Author Keywords: Multiple Scattering, Spray diagnostics, Markov Chain, Monte Carlo, Numerical simulation

articleTitle: Optimization Design and Vibration Characteristics Analysis of Drum Shearer's Haulage Unit
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: Owing to the large volume of the ordinary drum shearer, the drum shearer has high manufacturing cost and needs large driving torque. Based on the structure of the haulage unit of the ordinary drum shearer, a new structure of shearer's haulage unit was designed. The optimization design model of the transmission gear in the haulage unit was established, and the optimization design result was received by MATLAB. Then the dynamic simulation of ordinary and new haulage unit was implemented to analyze the vibration characteristics. Experimental research on the ordinary shearer haulage unit was carried out to verify the reliability of the simulation results. The results show that: the index circle diameter of the final ring gear of the new transmission gear is reduced by 21.4%, and the machine height of haulage unit is reduced by 61mm, with meeting the strength requirements. Compared with the ordinary haulage unit, the vibration acceleration amplitude of the new haulage unit is reduced by 8.89%, 16.67% and 20% in the X, Y and Z directions, respectively. Under the same working condition, the experimental results are consistent with the simulation results, which verify the reliability of the simulation results. The research results provide the basis for the optimization design and reliability evaluation of the shearer's haulage unit.

articleTitle: An Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Approach Based on Industrial Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The development of condition monitoring system provides large amounts of operational data. These data present typical characteristics of multiple sources, polymorphism, diversity and mass, and can reflect the service quality and operating state of the equipment. How to use these data becomes one of the main problems in data analysis. To address the issue, this paper presents a generalized model for complex mechanical system anomaly detection based on the data collected from distributed control system (DCS). The Stacked Auto-encoder network is used to achieve the automatic extraction of the hidden features in multidimensional polymorphic data. The isolation forest (IF) method is used to achieve the anomaly detection, which only needs to use the DCS monitoring data during normal operation of the unit for network training and model fitting without fault data. And the method can realize the abnormal detection during the operation of the unit without the traditional signal processing method for feature extraction. The proposed method has been used for real compressor. The results show that the proposed approach can detect the anomalies without the need for fault data. And the proposed method is more effective than traditional methods.

Author Keywords: Anomaly detection, DCS data, Stacked Autoencoder, Isolation Forest

articleTitle: Tooth Dynamic Contact Simulation and Experimental Validation of Involute Spur Gear
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To accurately simulate the dynamic characteristics of the gear system, the real tooth profile is considered. Based on the dynamic contact algorithm with distance detection and Hertzian contact method, the dynamic contact model of the involute gear teeth is established by considering the nonlinear factors such as the time-varying meshing stiffness, damping, and friction of the gear teeth. Using the secondary development platform of Adams Subroutine, the integration of the tooth contact module and multi-tooth contact module is implemented, and the dynamic gear model of gear is proposed. The dynamic contact force of a pair of gears under a given working condition is simulated, and the dynamic bending stress of the root is calculated by the dynamic contact force and the position of the meshing point. The meshing gears are tested under different working conditions to obtain dynamic bending stress. The experimental and simulation results of the root bending stress are compared to validate the accuracy of the proposed tooth contact model.

articleTitle: Research on Fatigue Reliability of Knotter Frame
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The D-type knotter is the core component of the square baler, and the fatigue fracture problem of the knotter frame is one of the main failure modes of the knotter. Aiming at the fatigue fracture problem of the knotter frame, a new type of frame with higher reliability is designed by using the fatigue reliability and fracture mechanics design method, which prolongs the minimum fatigue life of the original frame by 69%. According to the stress distribution cloud diagram of the worm shaft hole, the cold extrusion treatment of the oil injection hole on the worm shaft hole is proposed to solve the stress concentration problem at the worm shaft hole. According to the idea of damage tolerance design, based on the residual strength theory, the crack damage tolerance of the crack near the oil hole is calculated. It is concluded that the crack should be strengthened and maintained when the total crack growth length reaches about 10 mm. Finally, the modal analysis of the new and old frame shows that the natural frequency of the new frame is significantly higher than that of the original frame, indicating that the overall reliability of the new frame is greatly improved compared with the original frame.

articleTitle: Study on Vibration Fatigue Life of Vehicle Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: The vibration fatigue life assessment of vehicle radar is carried out according to the random load of transportation faced by vehicle radar in service. The refined finite element model of vehicle-mounted radar in transportation state is established to investigate its inherent characteristics. Based on modal method, Frequency response analysis and random vibration analysis was carried out. Based on S-N curve and cumulative damage theory, fatigue life prediction was carried out. The results show that the fatigue damage of dangerous parts is very big. So it is suggested to improve the structure to reduce the stress concentration, use different materials in different parts, improve the processing technology to improve the strength, etc.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Different Methods of Measuring Dynamic Characteristics of the Plasma Synthetic Jet
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd World Conference on Mechanical Engineering and Intelligent Manufacturing (WCMEIM)
abstract: To investigate the dynamic characteristics of a plasma synthetic jet (PSJ), we used dynamic pressure sensors and high-speed schlieren method to study the similarities and differences of the dynamic characteristics of PSJ under the same PSJ structural and electrical parameters. It was observed that the excitation frequency of the jet measured by the above two approaches was consistent with the discharge frequency of PSJ under the test actuation frequency. When the actuation frequency was between 100 Hz and 200 Hz, the jet duration in one cycle obtained by the schlieren was about 12% longer than that measured by the dynamic pressure sensor. While the excitation frequency was reduced to 50 Hz, the jet duration measured by the schlieren became shorter than that got by the dynamic pressure sensor. Although the specific values of the jet velocity of PSJ measured by the two methods were different, the trend of the peck velocity was similar obtained by the schlieren and pressure sensor.
